title: Large-scale Repository Engineering via Agent-Native Reusable Code Primitives
title_zh: 基于智能体原生可复用代码原语的大规模仓库工程

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) equipped with development environments have moved code generation toward repository-scale construction, yet building complete repositories remains difficult because interacting modules, interfaces, configurations, tests, and dependencies must work together. We introduce Code Primitives , agent-native reusable executable components that carry their own interface contracts, dependency closures, validation tests, and provenance. Each primitive uses a resident LLM as a natural-language interface to assess relevance and adapt its implementation, interfaces, and dependencies to the target repository, and we organize 1,424 1{,}424 validated primitives in CodeFace , a searchable library for repository construction. Each primitive adapts the component it owns. We introduce LEGO ( L arge-scale repository E ngineering via a G ent-native reusable c O de primitives), which activates the primitives a task requires, integrates their adapted implementations with task-specific code while resolving constraints that cross component boundaries, and revises the result against executed tests. To measure construction end to end we build LEGO-REPO , a benchmark of 522 522 executable reconstruction tasks spanning seven software domains, 22 22 capability tracks, and five difficulty levels, each scored against the package’s native test suite between an empty-package floor and an original-source ceiling. The strongest of 13 13 evaluated backbones reaches a delivery score of 0.318 0.318 and scores zero on 41.0 % 41.0\% of tasks; LEGO improves all 13 13 by 0.1474 0.1474 on average and raises GPT-5.6-terra from 0.3180 0.3180 to 0.5134 0.5134 ( + 61.4 % +61.4\% ). In controlled comparisons, adapted primitives achieve higher delivery scores than retrieved code supplied as context or vendored unchanged. The effect persists against independent repository agents, across three external benchmarks, and with a disjointly re-mined CodeFace, and using GPT-OSS-20B for adaptation and diagnosis retains 95.1 % 95.1\% of the homogeneous score at 24.0 % 24.0\% lower cost.
paragraphs.zh: 配备开发环境的大型语言模型（LLM）已将代码生成推进到仓库级构建，但要构建完整的仓库仍然困难，因为相互作用的模块、接口、配置、测试和依赖项必须协同工作。 我们提出了 Code Primitives——一种面向智能体的可重用执行组件，它们自带接口契约、依赖闭包、验证测试和来源信息。 每个原语都使用一个常驻的 LLM 作为自然语言接口，以评估相关性并调整其实现、接口和依赖项以适应目标仓库；我们在 CodeFace 中组织了 1,424 个经过验证的原语，这是一个可用于仓库构建的可搜索库。 每个原语都会调整其所属的组件。 我们提出了 LEGO（通过面向智能体的可重用代码原语实现的大规模仓库工程），它能激活任务所需的原语，将调整后的实现与任务特定代码集成，同时解决跨组件边界的约束，并基于执行结果对输出进行修订。 为了端到端地衡量构建效果，我们构建了 LEGO-REPO——一个包含 522 个可执行重构任务的基准测试，涵盖七个软件领域、22 个能力轨道和五个难度等级；每个任务都在空包基线和原始源代码上限之间，通过该包的本地测试套件进行评分。 在评估的 13 种基础模型中，表现最强的模型交付得分为 0.318，但在 41.0% 的任务中得分为零；LEGO 使所有 13 种模型的平均得分提升了 0.1474，并将 GPT-5.6-terra 的得分从 0.3180 提高到 0.5134（+61.4%）。 在受控对比中，调整后的原语比作为上下文提供的检索代码或未经修改的第三方代码获得了更高的交付得分。 这种效果在面对独立的仓库智能体、三个外部基准测试以及一个独立重新采样的 CodeFace 时依然有效；使用 GPT-OSS-20B 进行适配和诊断，在成本降低 24.0% 的情况下仍保留了 95.1% 的同质得分。

paragraphs.en: Large language models with development environments have moved code generation from isolated programs toward repository-scale construction ( OpenAI, 2025 ; Anthropic, 2025 ; GitHub, 2025 ; Peng et al., 2026 ; Ding et al., 2025 ) , a setting requiring complete projects whose modules, interfaces, configurations, tests and dependencies work together. paragraphs.zh: 配备开发环境的大型语言模型已将代码生成从孤立程序转向仓库级构建（OpenAI，2025；Anthropic，2025；GitHub，2025；Peng 等，2026；Ding 等，2025），这种模式需要完整的项目，其模块、接口、配置、测试和依赖项必须协同工作。 这一转变引发了三个关于如何可靠构建此类仓库的高级设计问题。

sents.en: This shift raises three high-level design questions about how such repositories can be reliably constructed.
sents.zh: 这一转变引发了三个关于如何可靠构建此类仓库的高级设计问题。

paragraphs.en: (1) How reliably can frontier models construct a complete repository end to end? Existing evaluations confirm the difficulty: on RepoZero-Py2JS, Claude Sonnet 4.6 with mini-SWE-agent reaches a 54.7 % 54.7\% pass rate ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , with similar results elsewhere ( Luo et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) . On our benchmark, the strongest of 13 13 LLMs reaches a delivery score of 0.318 0.318 , where 0 0 denotes the empty-package floor and 1 1 the behaviour of the original source, and scores zero on 41.0 % 41.0\% of 522 522 tasks; Claude Opus 5 reaches 0.237 0.237 and matches the original behaviour on 5.9 % 5.9\% ; and the mean score across backbones falls 10.3 × 10.3\times from the smallest to the largest difficulty band. These results motivate approaches that reuse and coordinate existing software capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: (1) 前沿模型能够以多高的可靠性从头到尾构建一个完整的代码库？ 现有评估证实了这一难度：在 RepoZero-Py2JS 测试中，配备 mini-SWE-agent 的 Claude Sonnet 4.6 达到了 54.7% 的通过率（Zhang et al., 2026b），其他研究也获得了类似结果（Luo et al., 2026；Chen et al., 2026）。 在我们的基准测试中，13 个 LLM 中最强的模型交付得分为 0.318，其中 0 表示空包基线，1 表示原始源代码的行为，且它在 522 项任务中的 41.0% 上得分为零；Claude Opus 5 的得分为 0.237，在 5.9% 的任务中匹配了原始行为；而各基础模型的平均得分从最低难度区间到最高难度区间下降了 10.3 倍。 这些结果促使人们采用能够复用并协调现有软件能力的方案。

sents.en: (1) How reliably can frontier models construct a complete repository end to end?
sents.zh: (1) 前沿模型能够以多高的可靠性从头到尾构建一个完整的代码库？

sents.en: These results motivate approaches that reuse and coordinate existing software capabilities.
sents.zh: 这些结果促使人们采用能够复用并协调现有软件能力的方案。

paragraphs.en: (2) What reusable abstraction can better support repository construction? Prior work encapsulates reusable capabilities as agent-native behaviors and executable tools ( Jin et al., 2026a ; Jin et al., 2026b ) , which are typically invoked externally and remain fixed during use. Repository construction requires a different form of reuse: the reused artifact becomes part of the delivered source, so its interfaces, dependencies, and configuration must be reconciled with the target repository. This form of reuse combines retrieval with adaptation. We introduce Code Primitives , reusable executable components that carry their own interface contracts, dependency closures, validation tests, and provenance. Each primitive uses a resident LLM as its natural-language interface to assess relevance and adapt its implementation, interfaces, and dependencies to the target. We then mine and validate these primitives from real-world repositories and organize them into CodeFace , a library of 1,424 1{,}424 Code Primitives.
paragraphs.zh: (2) 哪种可重用的抽象层能更好地支持仓库构建？ 先前的研究将可重用的能力封装为智能体原生的行为和可执行工具（Jin et al., 2026a; Jin et al., 2026b），这些通常由外部调用，并在使用过程中保持固定不变。 仓库构建需要一种不同的复用形式：被复用的构件会成为交付源代码的一部分，因此其接口、依赖关系和配置必须与目标仓库协调一致。 这种复用形式将检索与适配相结合。 我们提出了“代码原语”（Code Primitives），即带有自身接口契约、依赖闭包、验证测试和来源信息的可重用执行组件。 每个原语都使用一个常驻的大型语言模型作为其自然语言接口，以评估相关性，并针对目标环境适配其实现、接口和依赖关系。 随后，我们从真实世界的仓库中挖掘并验证这些原语，将它们组织成“CodeFace”——一个包含 1,424 个代码原语的库。

sents.en: (2) What reusable abstraction can better support repository construction?
sents.zh: (2) 哪种可重用的抽象层能更好地支持仓库构建？

paragraphs.en: (3) What construction pipeline can better leverage reusable software capabilities? We treat repository construction as resolving a specification against existing capabilities and integrating reusable components with task-specific code. We introduce LEGO ( L arge-scale repository E ngineering via a G ent-native reusable c O de primitives), which coordinates Code Primitives through three mechanisms: retrieval and activation decomposes a request into required capabilities and activates only the primitives that cover them; primitive collaboration lets activated primitives adapt their implementations while propagating interface and dependency requirements to connected components; and diagnosis and verification executes available and synthesized tests, localizes failures to components or their interactions, and reactivates affected primitives for revision. This loop integrates retrieval, adaptation, and verification until validation succeeds or the construction budget is exhausted. To evaluate LEGO, we introduce LEGO-REPO , a benchmark of 522 522 executable reconstruction tasks drawn from real GitHub projects across seven software domains, 22 22 capability tracks, and five measured difficulty levels ( D1–D5 ). Each task reconstructs a Python package from its public interface and evaluates it against the package’s native test suite.
paragraphs.zh: (3) 哪种构建流程能更好地利用可重用的软件能力？ 我们将仓库构建视为将规格与现有能力进行匹配，并将可重用组件与任务特定代码集成的过程。 我们提出了 LEGO（通过原生智能体可重用代码原语实现的大规模仓库工程），它通过三种机制协调代码原语：检索与激活将请求分解为所需能力，并仅激活覆盖这些能力的原语；原语协作使已激活的原语能够调整其实现，同时将接口和依赖要求传播给相连的组件；诊断与验证则执行可用和合成的测试，定位故障到具体组件或其交互，并重新激活受影响的原语以供修订。 该循环持续整合检索、适配和验证，直到验证成功或构建预算耗尽。 为评估 LEGO，我们引入了 LEGO-REPO——一个基准数据集，包含 522 个可执行的重建任务，这些任务来自七个软件领域的真实 GitHub 项目，涵盖 22 条能力轨道和五个已量化的难度等级（D1–D5）。 每个任务都基于公共接口重建一个 Python 包，并依据该包的原始测试套件对其进行评估。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the aforementioned questions through six empirical RQs spanning from-scratch construction, reusable capabilities, construction mechanisms, model substitution, cost, and transfer. Across LEGO-REPO , LEGO improves all 13 13 evaluated backbones, with a mean absolute gain of 0.1474 0.1474 ( + 76.5 % +76.5\% relative). Under GPT-5.6-terra, the delivery score rises from 0.3180 0.3180 to 0.5134 0.5134 ( + 61.4 % +61.4\% ), with fewer zero-score tasks and more repositories reproducing original-source behavior. The gains persist against independent repository agents, on three external benchmarks, and with a disjointly re-mined CodeFace. Adapted primitives also outperform retrieved code used as read-only context or vendored unchanged. Finally, GPT-OSS-20B adaptation and diagnosis retain 95.1 % 95.1\% of the homogeneous GPT-5.6-terra score at 24.0 % 24.0\% lower cost. Our main contributions are as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过六个经验性研究问题（RQ）来评估上述问题，这些问题涵盖了从头构建、可重用能力、构建机制、模型替换、成本以及迁移等方面。 在 LEGO-REPO 中，LEGO 提升了所有 13 个被评估的基线模型，平均绝对增益为 0.1474（相对提升 +76.5%）。 在 GPT-5.6-terra 下，交付得分从 0.3180 提升至 0.5134（+61.4%），零分任务减少，同时有更多仓库能够复现原始源代码的行为。 这些增益在面对独立的仓库智能体时依然有效，并在三个外部基准测试以及一个独立重新挖掘的 CodeFace 数据集上得到了验证。 经过适配的原语也比作为只读上下文使用的检索代码或未经修改直接引入的代码表现更优。 最后，GPT-OSS-20B 的适配与诊断在成本降低 24.0% 的情况下，仍保留了均匀 GPT-5.6-terra 得分的 95.1%。 我们的主要贡献如下：

sents.en: We evaluate the aforementioned questions through six empirical RQs spanning from-scratch construction, reusable capabilities, construction mechanisms, model substitution, cost, and transfer.
sents.zh: 我们通过六个经验性研究问题（RQ）来评估上述问题，这些问题涵盖了从头构建、可重用能力、构建机制、模型替换、成本以及迁移等方面。

sents.en: Across LEGO-REPO , LEGO improves all 13 13 evaluated backbones, with a mean absolute gain of 0.1474 0.1474 ( + 76.5 % +76.5\% relative).
sents.zh: 在 LEGO-REPO 中，LEGO 提升了所有 13 个被评估的基线模型，平均绝对增益为 0.1474（相对提升 +76.5%）。

sents.en: Under GPT-5.6-terra, the delivery score rises from 0.3180 0.3180 to 0.5134 0.5134 ( + 61.4 % +61.4\% ), with fewer zero-score tasks and more repositories reproducing original-source behavior.
sents.zh: 在 GPT-5.6-terra 下，交付得分从 0.3180 提升至 0.5134（+61.4%），零分任务减少，同时有更多仓库能够复现原始源代码的行为。

sents.en: The gains persist against independent repository agents, on three external benchmarks, and with a disjointly re-mined CodeFace.
sents.zh: 这些增益在面对独立的仓库智能体时依然有效，并在三个外部基准测试以及一个独立重新挖掘的 CodeFace 数据集上得到了验证。

sents.en: Adapted primitives also outperform retrieved code used as read-only context or vendored unchanged.
sents.zh: 经过适配的原语也比作为只读上下文使用的检索代码或未经修改直接引入的代码表现更优。

sents.en: Finally, GPT-OSS-20B adaptation and diagnosis retain 95.1 % 95.1\% of the homogeneous GPT-5.6-terra score at 24.0 % 24.0\% lower cost.
sents.zh: 最后，GPT-OSS-20B 的适配与诊断在成本降低 24.0% 的情况下，仍保留了均匀 GPT-5.6-terra 得分的 95.1%。

sents.en: Our main contributions are as follows:
sents.zh: 我们的主要贡献如下：

paragraphs.en: We design Code Primitives , agent-native reusable software components that carry their own interface contracts, dependencies, validation tests, and provenance, and adapt themselves to target repositories through their natural-language interfaces. We further build CodeFace , a library of 1,424 1{,}424 validated Code Primitives for retrieval and reuse.
paragraphs.zh: 我们设计了 Code Primitives，这是一种面向智能体的可重用软件组件，它们自带接口契约、依赖项、验证测试和来源信息，并通过其自然语言接口适应目标仓库。 我们还构建了 CodeFace，这是一个包含 1,424 个经过验证的 Code Primitives 的库，可供检索和重用。

sents.en: We design Code Primitives , agent-native reusable software components that carry their own interface contracts, dependencies, validation tests, and provenance, and adapt themselves to target repositories through their natural-language interfaces.
sents.zh: 我们设计了 Code Primitives，这是一种面向智能体的可重用软件组件，它们自带接口契约、依赖项、验证测试和来源信息，并通过其自然语言接口适应目标仓库。

sents.en: We further build CodeFace , a library of 1,424 1{,}424 validated Code Primitives for retrieval and reuse.
sents.zh: 我们还构建了 CodeFace，这是一个包含 1,424 个经过验证的 Code Primitives 的库，可供检索和重用。

paragraphs.en: We introduce LEGO , a repository-construction framework built on CodeFace that makes this abstraction usable at repository scale: it activates only the primitives a task requires, delegates adaptation to the component that owns each implementation, and uses executed tests to guide integration and revision across component boundaries.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 LEGO，这是一个基于 CodeFace 构建的仓库级框架，使这种抽象能够在整个仓库规模上得以应用：它仅激活任务所需的原始组件，将适配工作委托给每个实现的所属组件，并利用已执行的测试来指导跨组件边界的集成与修订。

paragraphs.en: Experiments on LEGO-REPO , our benchmark of 522 522 repository-reconstruction tasks, show that LEGO improves all 13 13 evaluated LLMs by 0.1474 0.1474 on average and raises GPT-5.6-terra from 0.3180 0.3180 to 0.5134 0.5134 ( + 61.4 % +61.4\% ). With matched backbones, LEGO outperforms OpenHands (GPT-5.6-terra) by 57.3 % 57.3\% and Claude Code (Claude Sonnet 5) by 56.2 % 56.2\% , while GPT-OSS-20B adaptation and diagnosis retain 95.1 % 95.1\% of the homogeneous GPT-5.6-terra score at 24.0 % 24.0\% lower cost.
paragraphs.zh: 在 LEGO-REPO（我们包含 522 个仓库重构任务的基准数据集）上的实验表明，LEGO 使所有 13 款经过评估的 LLM 的性能平均提升了 0.1474，并将 GPT-5.6-terra 的性能从 0.3180 提升至 0.5134（+61.4%）。 在相同基础模型配置下，LEGO 的性能比 OpenHands（GPT-5.6-terra）高出 57.3%，比 Claude Code（Claude Sonnet 5）高出 56.2%；同时，GPT-OSS-20B 的适配与诊断功能在成本降低 24.0% 的情况下，仍保留了 95.1% 的 GPT-5.6-terra 同构模型得分。

paragraphs.en: Coding agents and repository-level evaluation. LLM-based software engineering has progressed from direct code generation toward agents that explore repositories, localize code, edit, execute, and iterate from feedback ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Xia et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Le et al., 2025 ) , with evaluation expanding from standalone functions ( Chen et al., 2021 ; Zhuo et al., 2025 ) to cross-file context ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Ding et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2024 ) , repository repair ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Le et al., 2025 ) , and zero-to-one repository generation ( Zhang et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2026a ; Luo et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) . Execution-guided refinement is a complementary mechanism ( Chen et al., 2022 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 编码智能体与仓库级评估。 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的软件工程已从直接生成代码，发展为能够探索仓库、定位代码、编辑代码、执行代码并根据反馈进行迭代改进的智能体（Yang et al., 2024；Zhang et al., 2024；Xia et al., 2024；Wang et al., 2025；Le et al., 2025），其评估范围也从独立功能（Chen et al., 2021；Zhuo et al., 2025）扩展到了跨文件上下文（Liu et al., 2024；Ding et al., 2023；Li et al., 2024）、仓库修复（Jimenez et al., 2024；Le et al., 2025），以及从零到一的仓库生成（Zhang et al., 2026b；Li et al., 2026a；Luo et al., 2026；Chen et al., 2026）。 执行引导的优化是一种互补机制（Chen et al., 2022；Shinn et al., 2023）。

sents.en: Coding agents and repository-level evaluation.
sents.zh: 编码智能体与仓库级评估。

paragraphs.en: Software reuse, retrieval, and reusable abstractions. Software reuse has long emphasized interface compatibility and adaptation cost ( Szyperski et al., 2002 ) . Learned systems construct reusable libraries, abstractions, skills, or tools ( Ellis et al., 2021 ; Grand et al., 2024 ; Stengel-Eskin et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Cai et al., 2024 ; Yuan et al., 2024 ) ; retrieval-augmented generation supplies existing code or repository context ( Lu et al., 2022 ; Zhou et al., 2022 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ) ; and Agent Primitives ( Jin et al., 2026a ) and Tool Primitives ( Jin et al., 2026b ) expose reusable behaviors and tools through agent-native interfaces. These approaches typically reuse artifacts as context or through fixed interfaces, rather than adapting them as part of the delivered repository.
paragraphs.zh: 软件复用、检索与可复用抽象。 软件复用长期以来一直强调接口兼容性和适配成本（Szyperski 等，2002）。 学习型系统会构建可复用的库、抽象、技能或工具（Ellis 等，2021；Grand 等，2024；Stengel-Eskin 等，2024；Wang 等，2024；Cai 等，2024；Yuan 等，2024）；检索增强生成会提供现有代码或代码库上下文（Lu 等，2022；Zhou 等，2022；Zhang 等，2023）；而智能体原语（Jin 等，2026a）和工具原语（Jin 等，2026b）则通过智能体原生接口暴露可复用的行为和工具。 这些方法通常将成果作为上下文或通过固定接口进行复用，而不是在交付的代码库中对其进行适配。

sents.en: Software reuse, retrieval, and reusable abstractions.
sents.zh: 软件复用、检索与可复用抽象。

sents.en: Software reuse has long emphasized interface compatibility and adaptation cost ( Szyperski et al., 2002 ) .
sents.zh: 软件复用长期以来一直强调接口兼容性和适配成本（Szyperski 等，2002）。

sents.zh: 学习型系统会构建可复用的库、抽象、技能或工具（Ellis 等，2021；Grand 等，2024；Stengel-Eskin 等，2024；Wang 等，2024；Cai 等，2024；Yuan 等，2024）；检索增强生成会提供现有代码或代码库上下文（Lu 等，2022；Zhou 等，2022；Zhang 等，2023）；而智能体原语（Jin 等，2026a）和工具原语（Jin 等，2026b）则通过智能体原生接口暴露可复用的行为和工具。

sents.en: These approaches typically reuse artifacts as context or through fixed interfaces, rather than adapting them as part of the delivered repository.
sents.zh: 这些方法通常将成果作为上下文或通过固定接口进行复用，而不是在交付的代码库中对其进行适配。

paragraphs.en: Key Differences. Prior reusable abstractions are typically consumed by invocation or as retrieved context: the artifact remains fixed while a central agent decides how to use it. Code Primitives instead support reuse by adaptation . Each primitive becomes part of the delivered repository, carries its own interface contract, dependency closure, and validation tests, and can modify its implementation and dependencies to fit the target. This moves part of repository construction from a single generator into the components that own the reused functionality. LEGO then coordinates which primitives to activate, how their requirements propagate across components, and how failed executions trigger further revision. LEGO-REPO evaluates the resulting package end to end against the original repository’s native test suite. Extended comparisons appear in Appendix A .
paragraphs.zh: 关键差异。 以往的可重用抽象通常通过调用或作为检索到的上下文来使用：该工件保持固定，而一个中心智能体决定如何运用它。 相比之下，代码原语支持通过适配实现重用。 每个原语都成为交付仓库的一部分，拥有自己的接口契约、依赖闭包和验证测试，并且能够修改其实现和依赖项以适应目标。 这将仓库构建的部分工作从单一生成器转移到了拥有可重用功能的组件中。 LEGO 随后协调哪些原语需要激活、它们的需求如何在组件间传播，以及执行失败时如何触发进一步修订。 LEGO-REPO 会对最终生成的软件包进行全面评估，对照原始仓库的原生测试套件进行验证。 扩展比较内容见附录 A。

paragraphs.en: LEGO is a repository-construction pipeline built on CodeFace , a library of reusable Code Primitives (Figure 1 ). CodeFace is built once by mining real repositories into component-level primitives; construction then proceeds per task over the primitives a request activates. Adaptation is performed by the component that owns the implementation, while constraints that cross components are resolved at the repository level.
paragraphs.zh: LEGO 是一个基于 CodeFace 构建的仓库构建流程，而 CodeFace 是一个可重用的代码原语库（图 1）。 CodeFace 通过挖掘真实仓库中的组件级原语一次性构建完成；随后，构建过程会根据请求所激活的原语按任务进行。 适配由拥有实现代码的组件执行，而跨组件的约束则在仓库层面解决。

sents.en: LEGO is a repository-construction pipeline built on CodeFace , a library of reusable Code Primitives (Figure 1 ).
sents.zh: LEGO 是一个基于 CodeFace 构建的仓库构建流程，而 CodeFace 是一个可重用的代码原语库（图 1）。

sents.en: CodeFace is built once by mining real repositories into component-level primitives; construction then proceeds per task over the primitives a request activates.
sents.zh: CodeFace 通过挖掘真实仓库中的组件级原语一次性构建完成；随后，构建过程会根据请求所激活的原语按任务进行。

sents.en: Adaptation is performed by the component that owns the implementation, while constraints that cross components are resolved at the repository level.
sents.zh: 适配由拥有实现代码的组件执行，而跨组件的约束则在仓库层面解决。

paragraphs.en: A Code Primitive is a reusable executable software component equipped with a resident LLM. Each primitive implements a coherent capability and exposes a natural-language interface through which it can assess its relevance to a construction task and adapt itself to a target repository. A code primitive may span functions, classes, files, configuration, and supporting artifacts; its boundary is determined by functional coherence and the dependencies required for independent execution.
paragraphs.zh: 代码原语是一种可重用的可执行软件组件，内置了常驻的大型语言模型（LLM）。 每个原语都实现了一项连贯的能力，并通过自然语言接口暴露出来，借助该接口，它能够评估自身与构建任务的关联程度，并适应目标代码库。 一个代码原语可能涵盖函数、类、文件、配置及辅助工件；其边界由功能连贯性以及独立执行所需的依赖关系所决定。

sents.en: A Code Primitive is a reusable executable software component equipped with a resident LLM.
sents.zh: 代码原语是一种可重用的可执行软件组件，内置了常驻的大型语言模型（LLM）。

sents.en: Each primitive implements a coherent capability and exposes a natural-language interface through which it can assess its relevance to a construction task and adapt itself to a target repository.
sents.zh: 每个原语都实现了一项连贯的能力，并通过自然语言接口暴露出来，借助该接口，它能够评估自身与构建任务的关联程度，并适应目标代码库。

sents.en: A code primitive may span functions, classes, files, configuration, and supporting artifacts; its boundary is determined by functional coherence and the dependencies required for independent execution.
sents.zh: 一个代码原语可能涵盖函数、类、文件、配置及辅助工件；其边界由功能连贯性以及独立执行所需的依赖关系所决定。

paragraphs.en: Formally, we represent a primitive as P i = ( C i , I i , D i , V i , X i , M i ) P_{i}=(C_{i},I_{i},D_{i},V_{i},X_{i},M_{i}) , where C i C_{i} is the implementation, I i I_{i} the exposed interface and behavioural contract, D i D_{i} the dependency closure, V i V_{i} the validation tests carried by the primitive, X i X_{i} supporting context and provenance, and M i M_{i} the resident LLM. We write V i V_{i} rather than T i T_{i} because T T denotes a benchmark task in Section 4 . Granularity is induced by mining rather than manually tuned: in the evaluated snapshot the median primitive contains 214 214 lines across 2 2 files, exports 4 4 symbols, and carries 9 9 validation tests.
paragraphs.zh: 正式地，我们将一个原始单元表示为 P i = ( C i , I i , D i , V i , X i , M i ) P_{i}=(C_{i},I_{i},D_{i},V_{i},X_{i},M_{i})，其中 C i C_{i} 是实施部分，I i I_{i} 是暴露的接口和行为契约，D i D_{i} 是依赖闭包，V i V_{i} 是原始单元所执行的验证测试，X i X_{i} 是支持上下文和来源信息，而 M i M_{i} 是驻留的 LLM。 我们使用 V i V_{i} 而非 T i T_{i}，因为在第 4 节中，T T 表示基准任务。 粒度是通过挖掘而非手动调整产生的：在评估的快照中，中位原始单元包含 214 行代码（分布在 2 个文件中），导出 4 个符号，并包含 9 项验证测试。

paragraphs.en: CodeFace organizes the validated primitives as a library ℱ = { P i } i = 1 N \mathcal{F}=\{P_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N} . Rather than exposing the entire library in context, LEGO retrieves only the candidates required by the current task and invokes them on demand. paragraphs.zh: CodeFace 将经过验证的原语组织成一个库 ℱ = { P i } i = 1 N \mathcal{F}=\{P_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N}。 LEGO 不会在上下文中暴露整个库，而是仅检索当前任务所需的候选项，并在需要时调用它们。 每个条目都保留其来源信息，因此可以在分析过程中区分出通过挖掘、采集、网络获取和从目标派生而来的组件。 经过评估的快照包含 871 个通过挖掘获得的条目、343 个通过采集获得的条目以及 210 个通过网络获取的条目，总计 1,424 个经过验证的代码原语。

paragraphs.en: We recover executable, functionally coherent components from existing software in six steps: each repository is parsed into program entities and relations; a dependency graph records what each entity requires; the graph is segmented into components whose boundaries are refined against neighbouring code, documentation, and tests; each candidate’s interface is inferred from its exported symbols and observed usage; the reachable tests, configurations, and documentation are collected into V i V_{i} and X i X_{i} , with local helpers internalized and external requirements recorded in D i D_{i} ; and the candidate is synthesized into a Code Primitive and validated in isolation, build, import, runtime, and test failures guiding boundary refinement until it is admitted or excluded. Mining is supplemented by implementations harvested from verified construction runs and by targeted web sourcing under the same requirements. Appendix F details recovery, dependency closure, validation, and admission.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过六个步骤从现有软件中恢复出可执行且功能连贯的组件：首先将每个代码库解析为程序实体及其关系；接着用依赖图记录每个实体的需求；然后将该图划分为若干组件，并根据相邻代码、文档和测试对其边界进行优化；再根据候选组件导出的符号和实际使用方式推断其接口；随后收集可访问的测试用例、配置和文档，分别存入 V_i 和 X_i，同时将本地辅助工具内化，并将外部需求记录在 D_i 中；最后将候选组件合成一个代码原语，并单独进行验证，通过构建、导入、运行时和测试中的失败情况指导边界优化，直至其被接纳或排除。 除挖掘外，我们还从经过验证的构建运行中获取实现，并根据相同需求从网络中进行定向采集以补充数据。 附录 F 详细说明了恢复、依赖闭合、验证和接纳的流程。

paragraphs.en: LEGO-REPO evaluates reconstruction of real Python packages from their public interfaces and native tests: generated modules must function together under the repository’s original execution environment. This targets repository-level integration rather than isolated function generation, localized repair, or unconstrained design from natural-language specifications. We collect GitHub repositories with at least 1,000 1{,}000 stars, an installable package, and a runnable test suite, yielding 522 522 tasks after excluding security-sensitive projects. Each task freezes the repository commit, package interface, tests, environment, and reference test identifiers; original implementation files are removed before reconstruction. Full collection, inventory, and execution details appear in Appendices B – D .
paragraphs.zh: LEGO-REPO 评估从真实 Python 包的公开接口和本地测试中重建这些包的能力：生成的模块必须在仓库原有的执行环境中协同工作。 这项任务针对的是仓库级别的集成，而非孤立的函数生成、局部修复或基于自然语言规格的无约束设计。 我们收集了至少有 1,000 个星、一个可安装的包以及一个可运行的测试套件的所有 GitHub 仓库，在排除涉及安全敏感的项目后，最终得到了 522 个任务。 每个任务都会固定仓库的提交记录、包接口、测试用例、执行环境以及参考测试标识符；在重建之前，原始实现文件会被移除。 完整的收集、清单编制和执行细节见附录 B – D。

paragraphs.en: We operationalize the three questions in Section 1 as six empirical RQs: how reliably frontier models construct repositories from scratch (RQ1); what capability CodeFace supplies (RQ2) and which mechanisms convert it into working repositories (RQ3); whether the effect survives changes in the backbone, adaptation, and diagnosis models (RQ4); what it costs (RQ5); and whether it transfers beyond our benchmark (RQ6).
paragraphs.zh: 我们将第 1 节中的三个问题具体化为六个经验性研究问题（RQ）：前沿模型能多可靠地从头构建代码库（RQ1）；CodeFace 提供了哪些能力（RQ2），以及哪些机制将其转化为可用的代码库（RQ3）；这种效果在骨干模型、适配模型和诊断模型发生变化时是否仍然存在（RQ4）；这需要付出什么代价（RQ5）；以及这种能力能否迁移到我们基准测试之外的场景（RQ6）。

paragraphs.en: Configurations and metrics. Configurations are named by their active stages: retrieval ( R ), primitive adaptation ( A ), execution feedback ( V ), and diagnosis ( D ), with b = 5 b=5 attempts per module. E , F , I , and C denote generic editing, raw-file retrieval, vendor-and-invoke, and read-only context controls. GPT-5.6-terra is the default backbone, adaptation, and diagnosis model; full harness settings are given in Appendix I . We report normalized delivery score (Eq. 8 ), identity-ceiling rate ( Ceil@1 ), zero-score rate ( Dead@0 ), and recorded-call cost per task. Cost accounting is detailed in Appendix J ; every table below condenses a larger one in Appendix G , which also reports repeated seeds with paired bootstrap intervals, per-task win/tie/loss counts, the tasks where reuse hurts, and gain against adapted-primitive count.

paragraphs.en: Repository scale sharply amplifies the difficulty. The field mean drops from 0.393 0.393 on D1 (mean 6 6 modules) to 0.038 0.038 on D5 (mean 119 119 ), a 10.3 × 10.3\times reduction, while even the strongest D5 result reaches only 0.129 0.129 . Coordinating interfaces, dependencies, and repository-level constraints therefore becomes harder as the component count grows, motivating reuse and adaptation over reconstructing every component within one trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 仓库规模的急剧扩大显著增加了难度。 该领域的平均值从 D1（平均 6 个模块）时的 0.393 下降至 D5（平均 119 个模块）时的 0.038，降幅达 10.3 倍，而即便是 D5 最强的结果也仅达到 0.129。 因此，随着组件数量的增加，协调接口、依赖关系和仓库级别的约束变得愈发困难，这使得在单一轨迹中重新构建每个组件不如重用和适配现有组件更具吸引力。

paragraphs.en: The limitation is not our scaffold. Table 2 compares four independently developed systems under their native harnesses. OpenHands ( 0.3263 0.3263 ) and Claude Code ( 0.3170 0.3170 ) are close to our Feedback baseline ( 0.3180 0.3180 ), while SWE-agent and Agentless reach 0.2750 0.2750 and 0.2181 0.2181 . All four show similarly steep D1–D5 degradation. LEGO, by contrast, reaches 0.5134 0.5134 with GPT-5.6-terra; on the matched Claude Sonnet 5, it reaches 0.4953 0.4953 versus Claude Code’s 0.3170 0.3170 .
paragraphs.zh: 这个限制并非源于我们的框架。 表 2 比较了四个独立开发的系统在各自原生环境下的表现。 OpenHands ( 0.3263 0.3263 ) 和 Claude Code ( 0.3170 0.3170 ) 的表现接近我们的 Feedback 基线 ( 0.3180 0.3180 )，而 SWE-agent 和 Agentless 分别达到 0.2750 0.2750 和 0.2181 0.2181。 这四个系统在 D1–D5 阶段都表现出同样急剧的性能下降。 相比之下，LEGO 在使用 GPT-5.6-terra 时达到了 0.5134 0.5134；而在与之匹配的 Claude Sonnet 5 上，它达到了 0.4953 0.4953，远高于 Claude Code 的 0.3170 0.3170。

paragraphs.en: Reach is broad but only loosely related to benefit. Coverage exceeds 50 % 50\% in every domain, yet moving from the lowest-reach domain (crypto-security, 52.1 % 52.1\% ) to the highest (compilers-languages, 68.5 % 68.5\% ) changes the gain only from + .2259 +.2259 to + .2464 +.2464 . Paired bootstrap intervals exclude zero for the three domains holding 438 438 of the 522 522 tasks but not for crypto-security ( [ − .0310 , + .4790 ] [-.0310,+.4790] ; Appendix G.1 ). Coverage falls from 75.3 % 75.3\% on D1 to 56.7 % 56.7\% on D5 as mean repository size grows from 6 6 to 119 119 modules, yet the improvement moves the other way: relative to the same backbone without a library it rises monotonically, + 30.7 % +30.7\% , + 52.6 % +52.6\% , + 76.3 % +76.3\% , + 98.5 % +98.5\% , + 162.0 % +162.0\% from D1 to D5. Reuse contributes most exactly where construction from scratch fails most.
paragraphs.zh: 覆盖范围很广，但与益处的关联却仅止于表面。 每个领域的覆盖率都超过 50 % 50\%，然而从覆盖范围最低的领域（加密货币安全，52.1 % 52.1\%）转向最高的领域（编译器-语言，68.5 % 68.5\%），收益仅从 + .2259 +.2259 变为 + .2464 +.2464。 对于包含 522 个任务中的 438 个任务的三个领域，成对自助置信区间排除了零值；但加密货币安全领域除外（[ − .0310 , + .4790 ] [-.0310,+.4790]；附录 G.1）。 随着仓库平均规模从 6 个模块增长到 119 个模块，覆盖率从 D1 的 75.3 % 75.3\% 下降至 D5 的 56.7 % 56.7\%，但改进方向却相反：与没有库的相同基础架构相比，该指标从 D1 到 D5 持续上升，分别为 + 30.7 % +30.7\%、+ 52.6 % +52.6\%、+ 76.3 % +76.3\%、+ 98.5 % +98.5\% 和 + 162.0 % +162.0\%。 重用带来的贡献恰恰最大地体现在从头构建最失败的领域。

paragraphs.en: Activation uses a smaller share of available components at larger scales. Across the 522 522 runs backbones issue 5,515 5{,}515 queries ( 10.6 10.6 per task), primitives accept 4,412 4{,}412 of 11,030 11{,}030 candidates ( 40.0 % 40.0\% ), and 3,873 3{,}873 pass their carried tests ( 87.8 % 87.8\% , 7.4 7.4 per task), delivering adapted primitives into 16.9 % 16.9\% of all target modules. Acceptance is similar across scales ( 40.8 % 40.8\% on D1 against 40.0 % 40.0\% on D5), while adaptation success falls 8.1 8.1 points (Appendix G.2 ); half-size subsets score .0303 .0303 below the full snapshot, and retrieval depth is not binding either (Appendix G.8 ). The used fraction also falls: activation reaches 22.9 % 22.9\% of the D5 modules the library could have served against 61.1 % 61.1\% on D1, because queries per task rise 3.7 → 22.7 3.7\rightarrow 22.7 while modules rise 6 → 119 6\rightarrow 119 . On D5 the unexploited reachable modules are about 3.4 × 3.4\times those used, motivating request decomposition alongside library coverage.
paragraphs.zh: 在更大规模下，激活过程使用的可用组件比例更小。 在 522 次运行中，主干模型发出了 5,515 个查询（每个任务 10.6 个），基础单元接受了 4,412 个候选项（共 11,030 个，占比 40.0%），并有 3,873 个通过了所携带的测试（占比 87.8%，每个任务 7.4 个），从而将适配后的基础单元部署到了所有目标模块的 16.9% 中。 不同规模下的接受率相似（D1 上的接受率为 40.8%，D5 上为 40.0%），但适配成功率下降了 8.1 个百分点（见附录 G.2）；半尺寸子集的得分比完整快照低 0.0303，且检索深度也并非限制因素（见附录 G.8）。 使用的比例也下降了：激活过程仅覆盖了 D5 模块的 22.9%，而理论上库本可以覆盖 D1 上的 61.1% 模块，这是因为每个任务的查询数从 3.7 上升到了 22.7，而模块数量则从 6 增加到了 119。 在 D5 上，未被利用的可访问模块数量约为所用模块的 3.4 倍，这促使我们结合库覆盖范围对请求进行分解。

paragraphs.en: Adaptation yields the largest observed reuse gains. Import + + Call vendors the primitive unchanged and invokes it, scoring 0.3430 0.3430 against 0.3469 0.3469 for the diagnosis-equipped no-library reference. It helps on the two smallest bands, then falls below the reference by 0.013 0.013 , 0.047 0.047 and 0.075 0.075 on D3–D5. Context-only , which shows the primitive, its contract and its tests as read-only material, scores 0.3544 0.3544 ( + 0.0075 +0.0075 over the same reference). Full adaptation raises the score to 0.5134 0.5134 : 0.1590 0.1590 above context-only use and 0.1704 0.1704 above unchanged invocation. The generic-editing control lies between unchanged invocation and full adaptation, with successive increments of 0.0663 0.0663 and 0.1041 0.1041 .

paragraphs.en: Part of the margin is provenance, and it is not the larger part. Excluding all same-repository donors lowers coverage to 41.2 % 41.2\% and the score to 0.4743 0.4743 , with the effect concentrated on the largest bands (Appendix G.4 ). More importantly, a separately re-mined corpus-disjoint library still improves over Feedback by + 0.1348 +0.1348 , compared with + 0.1954 +0.1954 for the default library (Appendix G.17 ). The benefit therefore persists without target-repository provenance, though provenance matters more at scale.

paragraphs.en: We introduce Code Primitives , reusable software components that adapt their implementations, interfaces, and dependencies to target repositories, and LEGO , a framework that retrieves, coordinates, and verifies these primitives during repository construction. Across LEGO-REPO and three external benchmarks, LEGO improves all 13 13 evaluated backbones, with the largest gains coming from primitive construction and adaptation rather than retrieval alone. These gains persist under model substitution and corpus-disjoint libraries. We hope this work shifts repository-scale code generation from repeatedly rebuilding software capabilities toward accumulating, adapting, and reusing them.

paragraphs.en: Coding agents and repository-level evaluation. LLM-based software engineering has progressed from direct code generation toward agents that explore repositories, localize relevant code, plan edits, execute programs, and iterate from feedback ( Chen et al., 2021 ; Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Xia et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Le et al., 2025 ) . Evaluation has expanded accordingly, from standalone functions ( Chen et al., 2021 ; Austin et al., 2021 ; Hendrycks et al., 2021 ; Zhuo et al., 2025 ) to repository context and cross-file dependencies ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Ding et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Liang et al., 2025 ) , repository repair and evolution ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Le et al., 2025 ) , and zero-to-one repository generation ( Zhang et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2026a ; Luo et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) . Execution-guided refinement provides a complementary mechanism: CodeT ( Chen et al., 2022 ) uses generated tests for candidate selection, Self-Debugging ( Chen et al., 2024 ) revises from execution traces, and Reflexion ( Shinn et al., 2023 ) carries verbal feedback across attempts.
paragraphs.zh: 编码智能体与仓库级评估。 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的软件工程已从直接代码生成，逐步发展为能够探索仓库、定位相关代码、规划编辑、执行程序并根据反馈进行迭代改进的智能体（Chen et al., 2021；Jimenez et al., 2024；Yang et al., 2024；Zhang et al., 2024；Xia et al., 2024；Wang et al., 2025；Le et al., 2025）。 评估范围也相应扩展：从独立功能（Chen et al., 2021；Austin et al., 2021；Hendrycks et al., 2021；Zhuo et al., 2025）到仓库上下文与跨文件依赖关系（Liu et al., 2024；Ding et al., 2023；Li et al., 2024；Liang et al., 2025），再到仓库修复与演化（Jimenez et al., 2024；Le et al., 2025），以及从零开始生成完整仓库（Zhang et al., 2026b；Li et al., 2026a；Luo et al., 2026；Chen et al., 2026；Zhang et al., 2026a）。 执行引导的优化提供了一种互补机制：CodeT（Chen et al., 2022）利用生成的测试用例来选择候选方案，Self-Debugging（Chen et al., 2024）通过执行轨迹进行修订，而Reflexion（Shinn et al., 2023）则在不同尝试间传递语言反馈。

paragraphs.en: Software reuse, retrieval, and reusable abstractions. Reusable software components have long been studied in software engineering, where interface compatibility and adaptation cost determine whether reuse is preferable to rewriting ( Szyperski et al., 2002 ) . Learned systems extend this idea by constructing reusable libraries, abstractions, skills, or tools: DreamCoder ( Ellis et al., 2021 ) alternates synthesis with library compression, LILO ( Grand et al., 2024 ) augments learned abstractions with documentation, ReGAL ( Stengel-Eskin et al., 2024 ) refactors programs into generalizable abstractions, and TroVE ( Wang et al., 2024 ) , LATM ( Cai et al., 2024 ) , and CRAFT ( Yuan et al., 2024 ) build reusable tool or skill collections for later tasks. Retrieval-augmented code generation instead supplies existing source, documentation, or repository context to a generator ( Lu et al., 2022 ; Zhou et al., 2022 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ) , while AgentDistill ( Qiu et al., 2025 ) and CODESKILL ( Li et al., 2026b ) extract reusable task-solving procedures from agent trajectories. More recently, Agent Primitives ( Jin et al., 2026a ) and Tool Primitives ( Jin et al., 2026b ) expose reusable agent behaviours and executable tools through agent-native retrievable interfaces. Across these approaches, however, the reused artifact is typically supplied as context or invoked through a fixed interface rather than incorporated into and adapted with the delivered repository.
paragraphs.zh: 软件复用、检索与可复用抽象。 在软件工程领域，可复用的软件组件早已成为研究课题，其中接口兼容性与适配成本决定了复用是否优于重新编写（Szyperski 等，2002）。 学习型系统通过构建可复用的库、抽象、技能或工具扩展了这一理念：DreamCoder（Ellis 等，2021）交替进行合成与库压缩；LILO（Grand 等，2024）为学习到的抽象添加文档说明；ReGAL（Stengel-Eskin 等，2024）将程序重构为可泛化的抽象；而 TroVE（Wang 等，2024）、LATM（Cai 等，2024）和 CRAFT（Yuan 等，2024）则为后续任务构建可复用的工具或技能集合。 检索增强型代码生成则向生成器提供现有的源代码、文档或仓库上下文信息（Lu 等，2022；Zhou 等，2022；Zhang 等，2023），而 AgentDistill（Qiu 等，2025）和 CODESKILL（Li 等，2026b）则从智能体轨迹中提取可复用的任务解决流程。 近期，Agent Primitives（Jin 等，2026a）和 Tool Primitives（Jin 等，2026b）通过智能体原生的可检索接口，提供了可复用的智能体行为和可执行工具。 然而，在这些方法中，被复用的产物通常作为上下文提供或通过固定接口调用，而非被整合到所交付的仓库中并随之适配。

paragraphs.en: Key Differences. Our work differs from prior systems in three key respects. LEGO targets zero-to-one repository construction rather than editing an existing codebase, organizing planning, retrieval, adaptation, composition, and verification to produce a complete package from an empty tree. Unlike library-learning and retrieval-augmented methods that keep reused artifacts fixed or use them as context, Code Primitives become part of the delivered repository and adapt their implementations, interfaces, dependencies, and configuration to the target. The closest abstractions are Agent Primitives and Tool Primitives ( Jin et al., 2026a ; Jin et al., 2026b ) , whose agent-native interfaces support invocation ; Code Primitives instead provide an interface for adaptation , with their dependency closure and validation tests traveling with the component. Finally, LEGO-REPO evaluates an entire reconstructed package against the original repository’s native test suite under a common empty-package floor and original-source ceiling, rather than scoring a function, completion, patch, or resolved issue.
paragraphs.zh: 关键差异。 我们的工作在三个关键方面与现有系统有所不同。 LEGO 的目标是构建从零到一的仓库，而非编辑现有代码库；它将规划、检索、适配、组合和验证组织起来，从而从一个空树生成一个完整的软件包。 与那些将重用组件固定不变或仅作为上下文使用的库学习和检索增强方法不同，Code Primitives 会成为交付仓库的一部分，并使其实现、接口、依赖关系和配置适应目标环境。 最接近的抽象概念是 Agent Primitives 和 Tool Primitives（Jin et al., 2026a；Jin et al., 2026b），它们的智能体原生接口支持调用；而 Code Primitives 则提供一个用于适配的接口，其依赖闭包和验证测试会随组件一同传递。 最后，LEGO-REPO 在一个共同的空软件包基线和原始源代码上限下，使用原始仓库的原生测试套件来评估整个重构后的软件包，而不是对某个函数、完成项、补丁或已解决的问题进行评分。

sents.en: Key Differences.
sents.zh: 关键差异。

sents.en: Our work differs from prior systems in three key respects.
sents.zh: 我们的工作在三个关键方面与现有系统有所不同。

sents.en: LEGO targets zero-to-one repository construction rather than editing an existing codebase, organizing planning, retrieval, adaptation, composition, and verification to produce a complete package from an empty tree.
sents.zh: LEGO 的目标是构建从零到一的仓库，而非编辑现有代码库；它将规划、检索、适配、组合和验证组织起来，从而从一个空树生成一个完整的软件包。

sents.en: Unlike library-learning and retrieval-augmented methods that keep reused artifacts fixed or use them as context, Code Primitives become part of the delivered repository and adapt their implementations, interfaces, dependencies, and configuration to the target.
sents.zh: 与那些将重用组件固定不变或仅作为上下文使用的库学习和检索增强方法不同，Code Primitives 会成为交付仓库的一部分，并使其实现、接口、依赖关系和配置适应目标环境。

sents.en: The closest abstractions are Agent Primitives and Tool Primitives ( Jin et al., 2026a ; Jin et al., 2026b ) , whose agent-native interfaces support invocation ; Code Primitives instead provide an interface for adaptation , with their dependency closure and validation tests traveling with the component.
sents.zh: 最接近的抽象概念是 Agent Primitives 和 Tool Primitives（Jin et al., 2026a；Jin et al., 2026b），它们的智能体原生接口支持调用；而 Code Primitives 则提供一个用于适配的接口，其依赖闭包和验证测试会随组件一同传递。

sents.en: Finally, LEGO-REPO evaluates an entire reconstructed package against the original repository’s native test suite under a common empty-package floor and original-source ceiling, rather than scoring a function, completion, patch, or resolved issue.
sents.zh: 最后，LEGO-REPO 在一个共同的空软件包基线和原始源代码上限下，使用原始仓库的原生测试套件来评估整个重构后的软件包，而不是对某个函数、完成项、补丁或已解决的问题进行评分。

paragraphs.en: A primitive is invoked with a fixed four-part payload and must answer in a fixed schema. It receives (i) its own primitive ( C i , I i , D i , V i , X i ) (C_{i},I_{i},D_{i},V_{i},X_{i}) verbatim; (ii) the requirement r r as the backbone wrote it; (iii) a context slice naming the target module path, the symbols the module must export, and the signatures of the sibling components it must bind to; and (iv) the diagnostics e e from the previous adaptation attempt, if any. It receives no part of the target’s native test suite, no other module’s source, and no part of the repository-level plan or repository-level diagnosis. It must return a complete replacement implementation, an updated contract and dependency record, a mapping from each carried test in V i V_{i} to kept / rewritten / dropped with a justification for each drop, and the execution log of V i V_{i} against the rewritten component. A return that fails to parse, omits a field, or leaves a kept test failing is rejected with the failure attached and re-requested up to 3 3 times; if it still fails, the requirement is returned for repository-level handling and counts as an unsuccessful adaptation in Table 17 . Of the 4,412 4{,}412 primitive-accepted candidates, 712 712 are rejected at least once under this rule. Of these, 173 173 recover within the rejection budget, leaving 539 539 ultimately returned for repository-level handling. These are the same 539 539 unsuccessful adaptations in Table 17 ; the other 3,873 3{,}873 candidates pass validation.
paragraphs.zh: 一个原语调用时携带固定的四部分负载，且必须以固定格式响应。 它会接收：(i) 其自身的原语（C_i, I_i, D_i, V_i, X_i）的逐字副本；(ii) 要求 r 由主干所写的内容；(iii) 一个上下文片段，其中指定了目标模块路径、该模块必须导出的符号，以及它必须绑定的兄弟组件的签名；以及 (iv) 来自先前适配尝试的诊断信息 e（如果存在）。 它不会接收目标模块原生测试套件的任何部分、任何其他模块的源代码，也不会接收仓库级计划或仓库级诊断的任何内容。 它必须返回一个完整的替换实现、一个更新后的契约和依赖记录、一个将 V_i 中每个携带的测试映射到“保留”“重写”或“舍弃”的列表（并说明每次舍弃的理由），以及 V_i 针对重写后组件的执行日志。 如果返回值无法解析、缺少字段，或导致某个保留的测试失败，则会被拒绝，并附带失败信息；此过程最多重复 3 次。若仍失败，则该要求将被返回至仓库级处理，并在表 17 中计为一次未成功的适配。 在 4,412 个被原语接受的候选项中，有 712 个根据此规则至少被拒绝过一次。 其中，173 个在拒绝次数预算内恢复成功，其余 539 个最终被返回至仓库级处理。 这 539 个正是表 17 中列出的未成功适配；其余 3,873 个候选项通过了验证。

sents.en: It must return a complete replacement implementation, an updated contract and dependency record, a mapping from each carried test in V i V_{i} to kept / rewritten / dropped with a justification for each drop, and the execution log of V i V_{i} against the rewritten component.
sents.zh: 它必须返回一个完整的替换实现、一个更新后的契约和依赖记录、一个将 V_i 中每个携带的测试映射到“保留”“重写”或“舍弃”的列表（并说明每次舍弃的理由），以及 V_i 针对重写后组件的执行日志。

sents.en: A return that fails to parse, omits a field, or leaves a kept test failing is rejected with the failure attached and re-requested up to 3 3 times; if it still fails, the requirement is returned for repository-level handling and counts as an unsuccessful adaptation in Table 17 .
sents.zh: 如果返回值无法解析、缺少字段，或导致某个保留的测试失败，则会被拒绝，并附带失败信息；此过程最多重复 3 次。若仍失败，则该要求将被返回至仓库级处理，并在表 17 中计为一次未成功的适配。

sents.en: Of the 4,412 4{,}412 primitive-accepted candidates, 712 712 are rejected at least once under this rule.
sents.zh: 在 4,412 个被原语接受的候选项中，有 712 个根据此规则至少被拒绝过一次。

sents.en: Of these, 173 173 recover within the rejection budget, leaving 539 539 ultimately returned for repository-level handling.
sents.zh: 其中，173 个在拒绝次数预算内恢复成功，其余 539 个最终被返回至仓库级处理。

sents.en: These are the same 539 539 unsuccessful adaptations in Table 17 ; the other 3,873 3{,}873 candidates pass validation.
sents.zh: 这 539 个正是表 17 中列出的未成功适配；其余 3,873 个候选项通过了验证。

paragraphs.en: The scoped editing control in Section 5.4 differs from a primitive exactly in this contract, so it is worth seeing one instance concretely. CodeFace entry cf-0412/schema-coercion was mined from marshmallow : 261 261 lines across 2 2 files, exporting a field-coercion dispatcher and its error type, with 14 14 carried tests. Across the snapshot, entries have a median of 214 214 implementation lines (p25 96 96 , p75 468 468 ) across a median of 2 2 files (p75 4 4 ), exporting 4 4 symbols and carrying 9 9 tests. Reconstructing pandera (Appendix K ), LEGO issued the requirement “coerce untyped input to a declared field type, collecting per-field errors into one report rather than raising on the first failure; errors must carry a location path.” The primitive’s adaptation replaced the donor’s exception-per-field control flow with an accumulating error collector, renamed the exported error type to the target’s contract, moved the location path from a string to the target’s tuple representation, and dropped 3 3 of the 14 14 carried tests as donor-specific (they asserted on marshmallow ’s message formatting), rewriting 5 5 others against the new signatures and keeping 6 6 unchanged. The 11 11 retained tests passed on the rewritten component before it was handed back to repository-level composition, which then bound it to 4 4 sibling modules. A generic editor operating on the same retrieved file has no equivalent of that last check: it can produce the same rewrite, but it does not perform this carried-test check. This example illustrates the validation step studied by the 0.0338 0.0338 forward carried-tests contrast in Table 19 ; the example itself does not estimate that contrast’s effect size.
paragraphs.zh: 第 5.4 节中的范围限定编辑控件与原始控件的区别恰恰在于这一契约，因此有必要具体观察一个实例。 CodeFace 条目 cf-0412/schema-coercion 是从 marshmallow 中挖掘而来的：共包含 261 行代码，分布在 2 个文件中，导出一个字段类型强制转换分发器及其错误类型，并附带了 14 项测试。 在整个快照中，各条目的实现代码行数为 214 行（中位数），分布在 2 个文件（中位数）中（p25 为 96 行，p75 为 468 行），导出 4 个符号并附带 9 项测试。 在重构 pandera（附录 K）时，LEGO 提出了如下要求：“将未指定类型的输入强制转换为声明的字段类型，并将每个字段的错误汇总到一份报告中，而不是在首次失败时立即抛出；错误必须包含位置路径。”原始控件的适配版本用累积式错误收集器替换了原控件中逐字段抛异常的流程，将导出的错误类型重命名为目标控件的契约名称，将位置路径从字符串形式改为目标控件的元组表示形式，并舍弃了 14 项附带测试中的 3 项（因为这些测试针对 marshmallow 的消息格式进行了断言），重新编写了另外 5 项以适配新签名，其余 6 项则保持不变。 在将保留下来的 11 项测试用于经过重写的组件之前，这些测试均已通过；随后该组件被交还至仓库级别的组合模块中，并与 4 个同级模块进行了绑定。 作用于同一检索文件的通用编辑器没有与此最后一步检查相对应的机制：它虽然可以生成相同的重写结果，但不会执行这种附带测试的检查。 本例说明了表 19 中“0.0338”这一正向附带测试对比所研究的验证步骤；但该示例本身并未估算该对比效应量的大小。

paragraphs.en: Section 3.4 states the construction loop compactly. The stages in full are as follows.
paragraphs.zh: 第 3.4 节以简洁的方式描述了构建循环。 完整的各个阶段如下所示。

sents.en: Section 3.4 states the construction loop compactly.
sents.zh: 第 3.4 节以简洁的方式描述了构建循环。

sents.en: The stages in full are as follows.
sents.zh: 完整的各个阶段如下所示。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval and Activation. Given request q q and construction context 𝒞 t \mathcal{C}_{t} , LEGO derives a repository plan and decomposes the task into required capabilities together with their interface and dependency constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 检索与激活。 给定请求 q q 和构建上下文 𝒞 t \mathcal{C}_{t}，LEGO 会生成一个存储库计划，并将任务分解为所需的能力及其接口和依赖约束。

sents.en: Retrieval and Activation.
sents.zh: 检索与激活。

sents.en: Given request q q and construction context 𝒞 t \mathcal{C}_{t} , LEGO derives a repository plan and decomposes the task into required capabilities together with their interface and dependency constraints.
sents.zh: 给定请求 q q 和构建上下文 𝒞 t \mathcal{C}_{t}，LEGO 会生成一个存储库计划，并将任务分解为所需的能力及其接口和依赖约束。

paragraphs.en: For each required capability, LEGO retrieves candidate primitives from CodeFace; the evaluated configuration returns the top two candidates per capability query. Their primitives produce relevance assessments and usage proposals ( s i , u i ) (s_{i},u_{i}) , after which activation selects primitives based on capability coverage and compatibility with the rest of the planned repository. Requirements without a suitable primitive remain outside the library and must be written from scratch.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个所需能力，LEGO 会从 CodeFace 中检索候选基础组件；经过评估的配置会针对每个能力查询返回排名靠前的两个候选组件。 这些基础组件会生成相关性评估和用法建议（s_i, u_i）(s_{i},u_{i})，随后激活机制会根据能力覆盖范围以及与规划中其余组件库的兼容性来选择基础组件。 没有合适基础组件的需求将保留在组件库之外，必须从头编写。

sents.en: For each required capability, LEGO retrieves candidate primitives from CodeFace; the evaluated configuration returns the top two candidates per capability query.
sents.zh: 对于每个所需能力，LEGO 会从 CodeFace 中检索候选基础组件；经过评估的配置会针对每个能力查询返回排名靠前的两个候选组件。

sents.en: Their primitives produce relevance assessments and usage proposals ( s i , u i ) (s_{i},u_{i}) , after which activation selects primitives based on capability coverage and compatibility with the rest of the planned repository.
sents.zh: 这些基础组件会生成相关性评估和用法建议（s_i, u_i）(s_{i},u_{i})，随后激活机制会根据能力覆盖范围以及与规划中其余组件库的兼容性来选择基础组件。

sents.en: Requirements without a suitable primitive remain outside the library and must be written from scratch.
sents.zh: 没有合适基础组件的需求将保留在组件库之外，必须从头编写。

paragraphs.en: Primitive Adaptation and Collaboration. For each selected primitive, LEGO states the target requirements through its natural-language interface. The primitive then produces P ~ i \widetilde{P}_{i} , adapting the primitive’s implementation, interfaces, dependencies, and configuration while preserving its component-level validation contract.
paragraphs.zh: 基础适应与协作。 对于每个选定的基础模块，LEGO 会通过其自然语言接口说明目标要求。 随后，该基础模块会生成 P ~ i \widetilde{P}_{i}，在保持其组件级验证契约的同时，对其实现、接口、依赖关系和配置进行适应调整。

sents.en: Primitive Adaptation and Collaboration.
sents.zh: 基础适应与协作。

sents.en: For each selected primitive, LEGO states the target requirements through its natural-language interface.
sents.zh: 对于每个选定的基础模块，LEGO 会通过其自然语言接口说明目标要求。

sents.en: The primitive then produces P ~ i \widetilde{P}_{i} , adapting the primitive’s implementation, interfaces, dependencies, and configuration while preserving its component-level validation contract.
sents.zh: 随后，该基础模块会生成 P ~ i \widetilde{P}_{i}，在保持其组件级验证契约的同时，对其实现、接口、依赖关系和配置进行适应调整。

paragraphs.en: Repository Editing. The adapted implementations become part of the target repository. LEGO combines them with integration code and newly generated functionality, while resolving constraints that cross primitive boundaries, including API bindings, shared data representations and types, package dependencies, and configuration. Primitives handle local component adaptation; repository-level coordination remains outside the primitive.
paragraphs.zh: 仓库编辑。 经过适配的实现将成为目标仓库的一部分。 LEGO 将其与集成代码和新生成的功能相结合，同时解决跨越基础单元边界的约束条件，包括 API 绑定、共享数据表示和类型、包依赖以及配置。 基础单元负责本地组件的适配；仓库级别的协调则位于基础单元之外。

sents.en: Repository Editing.
sents.zh: 仓库编辑。

sents.en: The adapted implementations become part of the target repository.
sents.zh: 经过适配的实现将成为目标仓库的一部分。

sents.en: Primitives handle local component adaptation; repository-level coordination remains outside the primitive.
sents.zh: 基础单元负责本地组件的适配；仓库级别的协调则位于基础单元之外。

paragraphs.en: Execution and Feedback. LEGO executes the build checks and tests available in the target, supplemented with unit and integration tests synthesized from the requirements and the recorded interfaces.
paragraphs.zh: 执行与反馈。 LEGO 执行目标中可用的构建检查和测试，并辅以根据需求及记录接口合成的单元测试和集成测试。

sents.en: Execution and Feedback.
sents.zh: 执行与反馈。

sents.en: LEGO executes the build checks and tests available in the target, supplemented with unit and integration tests synthesized from the requirements and the recorded interfaces.
sents.zh: LEGO 执行目标中可用的构建检查和测试，并辅以根据需求及记录接口合成的单元测试和集成测试。

paragraphs.en: Verification and Diagnosis. The execution evidence is assessed against task completion, build success, test pass rate, interface consistency, and code quality. Build failures and failing tests are determined by execution and are terminal for the round. Diagnosis attributes the observed failures to individual components or their interactions and returns revision guidance, which reactivates only the implicated primitives. The loop continues until verification succeeds or the budget of b = 5 b=5 attempts per module is exhausted.
paragraphs.zh: 验证与诊断。 执行证据将依据任务完成度、构建成功情况、测试通过率、接口一致性和代码质量进行评估。 构建失败和测试失败由执行过程确定，并将导致该轮次终止。 诊断环节会将观察到的失败归因于单个组件或它们之间的交互，并返回修订指导，仅重新激活受影响的原始单元。 该循环将持续运行，直到验证成功，或者每个模块的 b = 5 次尝试预算用尽。

sents.en: Verification and Diagnosis.
sents.zh: 验证与诊断。

sents.zh: 执行证据将依据任务完成度、构建成功情况、测试通过率、接口一致性和代码质量进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Three properties of this loop matter for reading the ablations. First, Π t \Pi_{t} is recomputed at every round rather than fixed after planning, so a requirement that no primitive satisfies in round t t can be matched in round t + 1 t+1 once neighbouring interfaces have settled; this is why retrieval counts in Table 17 exceed one query per requirement. Second, 𝒞 t + 1 \mathcal{C}_{t+1} accumulates diagnostics monotonically and is never truncated within a task, so the attempt budget b b bounds the number of revisions but not the amount of evidence carried into the last one — the budget-dependent scores in Table 26 are therefore not an artefact of context loss. Third, Γ \Gamma is evaluated by the harness rather than by diagnosis: diagnosis diagnoses failures but does not decide admissibility, which keeps the scoring path of Eq. 9 independent of any model’s verdict. Disabling D removes ϕ t \phi_{t} from Eq. 18 and leaves LEGO with raw execution output; disabling A replaces P ~ i \widetilde{P}_{i} with P i P_{i} in the composition step; disabling R empties 𝒜 t \mathcal{A}_{t} . Each stage ablation in Table 4 is exactly one of these three substitutions.
paragraphs.zh: 该循环的三个特性对于解读消融分析至关重要。 首先，Π t \Pi_{t} 在每一轮都会重新计算，而不是在规划后固定不变；因此，某个需求在第 t 轮没有智能体满足，一旦相邻接口稳定下来，就可能在第 t + 1 轮被匹配到。这就是表 17 中的检索次数超过每个需求一次查询的原因。 其次，𝒞 t + 1 \mathcal{C}_{t+1} 会单调地累积诊断信息，且在一个任务中绝不会被截断；因此，尝试预算 b 限制了修订次数，但并未限制带入最后一次修订的证据量——表 26 中依赖预算的分数因而并非上下文丢失造成的产物。 第三，Γ \Gamma 由测试框架进行评估，而非通过诊断：诊断可以识别故障，但不会决定可接受性，这使得公式 9 的评分路径独立于任何模型的判断结果。 禁用 D 会将 ϕ t \phi_{t} 从公式 18 中移除，使 LEGO 仅保留原始执行输出；禁用 A 会在组合步骤中将 P ~ i \widetilde{P}_{i} 替换为 P i P_{i}；禁用 R 则会清空 𝒜 t \mathcal{A}_{t}。 表 4 中的每个阶段消融分析，恰好对应这三种替换之一。

sents.zh: 首先，Π t \Pi_{t} 在每一轮都会重新计算，而不是在规划后固定不变；因此，某个需求在第 t 轮没有智能体满足，一旦相邻接口稳定下来，就可能在第 t + 1 轮被匹配到。这就是表 17 中的检索次数超过每个需求一次查询的原因。

sents.en: Second, 𝒞 t + 1 \mathcal{C}_{t+1} accumulates diagnostics monotonically and is never truncated within a task, so the attempt budget b b bounds the number of revisions but not the amount of evidence carried into the last one — the budget-dependent scores in Table 26 are therefore not an artefact of context loss.
sents.zh: 其次，𝒞 t + 1 \mathcal{C}_{t+1} 会单调地累积诊断信息，且在一个任务中绝不会被截断；因此，尝试预算 b 限制了修订次数，但并未限制带入最后一次修订的证据量——表 26 中依赖预算的分数因而并非上下文丢失造成的产物。

sents.en: Third, Γ \Gamma is evaluated by the harness rather than by diagnosis: diagnosis diagnoses failures but does not decide admissibility, which keeps the scoring path of Eq. 9 independent of any model’s verdict.
sents.zh: 第三，Γ \Gamma 由测试框架进行评估，而非通过诊断：诊断可以识别故障，但不会决定可接受性，这使得公式 9 的评分路径独立于任何模型的判断结果。

sents.en: Disabling D removes ϕ t \phi_{t} from Eq. 18 and leaves LEGO with raw execution output; disabling A replaces P ~ i \widetilde{P}_{i} with P i P_{i} in the composition step; disabling R empties 𝒜 t \mathcal{A}_{t} .
sents.zh: 禁用 D 会将 ϕ t \phi_{t} 从公式 18 中移除，使 LEGO 仅保留原始执行输出；禁用 A 会在组合步骤中将 P ~ i \widetilde{P}_{i} 替换为 P i P_{i}；禁用 R 则会清空 𝒜 t \mathcal{A}_{t}。

sents.en: Each stage ablation in Table 4 is exactly one of these three substitutions.
sents.zh: 表 4 中的每个阶段消融分析，恰好对应这三种替换之一。

paragraphs.en: Two readings follow from the partition. In absolute terms the gain is nearly flat across bands ( .161 .161 to .209 .209 ), but it is measured against a baseline that is itself collapsing — D5 Feedback is .129 .129 against .525 .525 on D1, so the same absolute step is a far larger intervention at D5. Relative to the same backbone without a library the gain is monotone in scale: + 30.7 % +30.7\% , + 52.6 % +52.6\% , + 76.3 % +76.3\% , + 98.5 % +98.5\% , + 162.0 % +162.0\% from D1 to D5. We rest the scale claim on the relative column together with the band-resolved mechanism controls of RQ3, which are absolute and all change sign in the same direction, rather than on the ratio alone — a relative gain over a small baseline is easy to inflate, which is the caveat we attach to the weak backbones in Table 24 . Paired bootstrap intervals over tasks ( 10,000 10{,}000 resamples) on the Δ \Delta column are [ + .1356 , + .2351 ] [+.1356,+.2351] for machine-learning, [ + .1200 , + .1911 ] [+.1200,+.1911] for databases-storage and [ + .1755 , + .3103 ] [+.1755,+.3103] for compilers-languages; of the four small domains, graphics-vision [ + .1120 , + .2624 ] [+.1120,+.2624] and scientific-computing [ + .0301 , + .3802 ] [+.0301,+.3802] exclude zero, quant-finance has a wide interval ( [ + .0118 , + .4230 ] [+.0118,+.4230] ), and crypto-security [ − .0310 , + .4790 ] [-.0310,+.4790] does not exclude zero at all. The domain column also shows the opposite pattern from what a coverage-driven account would predict — crypto-security has the lowest reach ( 52.1 % 52.1\% ) and the highest Feedback score ( .3880 .3880 ), because its tasks are small and behaviourally tight, while machine-learning has the second-lowest reach and the lowest scores in both configurations because its band mix is the heaviest in the benchmark (Table 12 ). Domain, difficulty and coverage are therefore confounded by construction, and we use the band partition rather than the domain partition wherever a claim depends on scale.
paragraphs.zh: 该划分带来了两种解读。 从绝对值来看，增益在各频段内几乎保持平坦（.161 .161 至 .209 .209），但这一数值是相对于一个本身正在坍缩的基线测量的——D5 的反馈为 .129 .129，而 D1 的反馈为 .525 .525，因此相同的绝对步长在 D5 上意味着更大得多的干预。 与没有库的相同主干结构相比，增益随规模单调变化：从 D1 到 D5，分别为 +30.7% +30.7\%、+52.6% +52.6\%、+76.3% +76.3\%、+98.5% +98.5\% 和 +162.0% +162.0\%。 我们对规模变化的论断基于相对列以及 RQ3 中按频段分解的机制控制——这些控制是绝对的，且所有变化方向一致，而非仅基于比率——相对于较小的基线而言，相对增益很容易被夸大，这也是我们在表 24 中对较弱主干结构提出的警告。 针对 Δ \Delta 列的任务（10,000 10{,}000 次重采样）的成对自助区间如下：机器学习为 [+.1356, +.2351]，数据库-存储为 [+.1200, +.1911]，编译器-语言为 [+.1755, +.3103]；在四个小型领域中，图形-视觉 [+.1120, +.2624] 和科学计算 [+.0301, +.3802] 的区间均不包含零，量化金融的区间较宽（[+.0118, +.4230]），而加密货币-安全的区间为 [-.0310, +.4790]，完全包含零。 领域列也呈现出与覆盖驱动解释所预测的模式相反的情况——加密货币-安全领域的覆盖范围最低（52.1% 52.1\%），但反馈得分最高（.3880 .3880），因为其任务规模小且行为特征集中；而机器学习领域的覆盖范围第二低，并且在两种配置中的得分均最低，因为其在基准测试中的频段组合最为密集（表 12）。 因此，领域、难度和覆盖度在构造上存在混淆，当论断依赖于规模时，我们优先使用频段划分而非领域划分。

paragraphs.en: Table 17 keeps the two notions used in RQ2 separate. The module and coverage columns come from the offline reachability audit, whereas queries, retained candidates, and successful adaptations are measured during the actual LEGO construction runs. Across the 522 522 runs backbones issue 5,515 5{,}515 capability queries ( 10.6 10.6 per task) and top- 2 2 retrieval yields 11,030 11{,}030 candidate inspections; primitives retain 4,412 4{,}412 of them ( 40.0 % 40.0\% ) and 3,873 3{,}873 pass their carried tests after adaptation ( 87.8 % 87.8\% , or 7.4 7.4 per task). The remaining 539 539 retained candidates ( 12.2 % 12.2\% ) fail adaptation validation under the prompt contract and are returned for repository-level handling rather than counted as successful adaptations.
paragraphs.zh: 表 17 将 RQ2 中使用的两个概念区分开来。 模块和覆盖范围列来自离线可达性审计，而查询、保留候选项和成功适配则是在实际的 LEGO 构建运行过程中测量的。 在 522 次运行中，主干系统提出了 5,515 个能力查询（每任务 10.6 个），前 2 名检索产生了 11,030 次候选项检查；基础单元保留了其中 4,412 个（40.0%），并在适配后有 3,873 个通过了所执行的测试（87.8%，即每任务 7.4 个）。 其余 539 个保留的候选项（12.2%）在提示合同下的适配验证中失败，因此被返回至仓库级别进行处理，而非计为成功适配。

paragraphs.en: The funnel narrows in a way that the coverage column alone does not predict. Queries per task rise from 3.7 3.7 on D1 to 22.7 22.7 on D5 while mean module count per task rises from 6 6 to 119 119 , so the backbone does not attempt to source most of a large repository from the library: adapted primitives account for 46.0 % 46.0\% of D1 modules but 13.0 % 13.0\% of D5 modules. The two per-candidate rates behave differently from each other. Relevance acceptance is nearly flat — primitives accept 40.8 % 40.8\% of inspected candidates on D1 and 40.0 % 40.0\% on D5. Adaptation success declines from 93.0 % 93.0\% of accepted candidates on D1 to 84.9 % 84.9\% on D5, an 8.1 8.1 -point decline: a component that is relevant becomes harder to fit as the surrounding repository grows. The decline in the adapted-module share is 33.0 33.0 percentage points, compared with the 8.1 8.1 -point decline in adaptation success. This supports the observation in Section 5.3 : the gain on large repositories comes from a small number of well-integrated components, not from broad substitution.
paragraphs.zh: 漏斗的收窄方式并非仅凭覆盖列就能预测。 每个任务的查询次数从 D1 的 3.7 增至 D5 的 22.7，而每个任务的平均模块数量则从 6 增至 119，因此主干并未尝试从大型知识库中通过库获取大部分内容：在 D1 中，适配的原型模块占所有模块的 46.0%，而在 D5 中仅占 13.0%。 这两种每位候选人的比率表现不同。 相关性接受率几乎保持不变——在 D1 中，原型接受了所检查候选人的 40.8%，在 D5 中为 40.0%。 适配成功率从 D1 时已接受候选人的 93.0% 下降至 D5 的 84.9%，降幅为 8.1 个百分点：随着周围知识库的扩大，相关组件更难被适配。 适配模块比例的下降幅度为 33.0 个百分点，而适配成功率的下降幅度则为 8.1 个百分点。 这支持了第 5.3 节的观察结果：在大型知识库中获得的增益源于少数高度集成的组件，而非广泛的替代。

paragraphs.en: Diagnosis behaves like adaptation, with one difference worth noting. The nine diagnoses span .5007 .5007 – .5134 .5134 , a range of .0127 .0127 , and the weakest retains 62.5 % 62.5\% of the revision margin. The observed ranges, .0127 .0127 and .0309 .0309 , exceed the primary-configuration seed standard deviations of at most .0043 .0043 . Both are smaller than the .0339 .0339 and .1154 .1154 that removing diagnosis or adaptation costs outright. Cost moves in the opposite direction to intuition in one place: because the rate table spans two orders of magnitude, substituting a more expensive model raises the per-task recorded-call cost above the homogeneous default (Claude Sonnet 5 in either position reaches $ 2.30 \$2.30 against $ 2.08 \$2.08 ), so the sweep spans $ 1.84 \$1.84 – $ 2.30 \$2.30 for diagnosis and $ 1.81 \$1.81 – $ 2.30 \$2.30 for adaptation. Within the cheaper half the two channels are comparable rather than dominated by one: diagnosis is invoked once per revision round whereas adaptation is invoked once per candidate, and Table 17 records 7.4 7.4 successful adaptations per task, so substituting diagnosis buys at most $ 0.24 \$0.24 per task and substituting adaptation $ 0.27 \$0.27 . When both move to GPT-OSS-20B the saving is $ 0.50 \$0.50 (Table 27 ); the separate rounded savings sum to $ 0.51 \$0.51 , with the one-cent difference due to rounding. This is why RQ5 reports the combined T/O/O configuration rather than presenting either channel alone as the economisation.
paragraphs.zh: 诊断行为的特征类似于自适应，但有一个值得注意的区别。 九种诊断的数值范围从 .5007 .5007 到 .5134 .5134，跨度为 .0127 .0127，而最弱的一种仍保留了修订余量的 62.5 % 62.5\%。 观测到的范围 .0127 .0127 和 .0309 .0309 超过了主配置种子标准差的最大值 .0043 .0043。 这两个数值都小于直接移除诊断或自适应所分别产生的成本 .0339 .0339 和 .1154 .1154。 在某个方面，成本的变化方向与直觉相反：由于速率表跨越了两个数量级，替换为更昂贵的模型会使每项任务记录调用的成本高于均匀默认值（无论置于哪个位置，Claude Sonnet 5 的成本都达到 $ 2.30 \$2.30，而原值为 $ 2.08 \$2.08），因此诊断的成本跨度为 $ 1.84 \$1.84 – $ 2.30 \$2.30，自适应的成本跨度则为 $ 1.81 \$1.81 – $ 2.30 \$2.30。 在成本较低的区间内，这两种机制的表现相当，而非由其中一种主导：诊断在每个修订轮次中调用一次，而自适应则在每个候选项中调用一次；表 17 记录显示每项任务有 7.4 7.4 次成功自适应，因此替换诊断最多可节省 $ 0.24 \$0.24/项任务，替换自适应则可节省 $ 0.27 \$0.27。 当两者都改用 GPT-OSS-20B 时，可节省 $ 0.50 \$0.50（表 27）；单独取整后的节省额合计为 $ 0.51 \$0.51，其中一美分的差异源于四舍五入。 这就是为什么 RQ5 报告了组合 T/O/O 配置，而不是单独将任一机制作为成本优化方案呈现。

paragraphs.en: The band columns show that the library does not merely scale every backbone’s curve by a constant. For the two strongest backbones the largest relative gains fall on D3–D5; the relative-gain profile varies across the other backbones. The D5 column spans .012 .012 – .338 .338 , a 28.2 × 28.2\times range, against 1.4 × 1.4\times on D1, so substantial differences remain between backbones after reuse. The Δ rel \Delta_{\mathrm{rel}} column is sensitive to the scratch-score denominator. For the weaker backbones, D1–D2 contribute most of the absolute aggregate gain, while the largest percentage improvement can occur in another band. Statements about where reuse helps should therefore be read per band, and we make them only for the GPT-5.6-terra rows, which are the only ones with a full set of controls.
paragraphs.zh: 各频段列表明，该库并非简单地将每个背骨曲线的数值乘以一个常数进行缩放。 对于两个最强的背骨，最大的相对增益出现在 D3–D5；而其他背骨的相对增益分布则各不相同。 D5 列的跨度为 .012 – .338，即 28.2 倍的范围，而 D1 仅为 1.4 倍，因此即使经过重用，各背骨之间仍存在显著差异。 Δ rel 列对初始得分的分母较为敏感。 对于较弱的背骨，D1–D2 贡献了绝对总增益的大部分，而最大的百分比提升可能出现在其他频段。 因此，关于重用效果的具体结论应逐频段解读；我们仅针对 GPT-5.6-terra 行作出此类结论，因为该行是唯一包含完整控制组的行。

paragraphs.en: Two readings of Table 25 deserve comment. Growing the library from 871 871 mined entries to the full 1,424 1{,}424 ( + 63 % +63\% of entries, + 4.5 +4.5 coverage points) changes the score by 0.0113 0.0113 , and not monotonically: the 1,214 1{,}214 -entry snapshot scores 0.0039 0.0039 below the 1,081 1{,}081 -entry one. Retrieval depth behaves similarly, peaking at top- 3 3 ( + 0.0076 +0.0076 ) and falling back at top- 5 5 ( + 0.0049 +0.0049 ). The source-composition comparison changes both the size and contents of the library. To examine size separately, random subsets of CodeFace at 10 % 10\% , 25 % 25\% and 50 % 50\% of entries (three draws each, same task set and budget) score .4498 ± .0061 .4498\pm.0061 , .4714 ± .0043 .4714\pm.0043 and .4831 ± .0035 .4831\pm.0035 against .5134 .5134 at full size. Doubling from 50 % 50\% to 100 % 100\% yields + .0303 +.0303 , while the last + 63 % +63\% of entries in the source-composition comparison yields + .0113 +.0113 with a non-monotone path. Scores vary with both library size and composition. The same 50 % 50\% library with carried tests withheld from its primitives scores .3894 .3894 , a loss of .0937 .0937 against the tested half-library configuration, larger than the .0303 .0303 loss from halving the full library. Carried validation has the larger observed difference in this comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 表25中有两个读数值得评论。 将知识库从871个已挖掘条目扩展到完整的1,424个条目（+63%的条目，+4.5个覆盖点），会使分数变化0.0113，且这种变化并非单调的：包含1,214个条目的快照得分比包含1,081个条目的快照低0.0039。 检索深度表现类似，在top-3时达到峰值（+0.0076），然后在top-5时回落（+0.0049）。 来源构成的比较同时改变了知识库的大小和内容。 为了单独考察大小影响，对CodeFace进行了随机子集采样，分别取10%、25%和50%的条目（每次抽取三次，任务集和预算相同），其得分分别为0.4498±0.0061、0.4714±0.0043和0.4831±0.0035，而完整规模下的得分为0.5134。 从50%扩大到100%时，得分增加了+0.0303；而在来源构成比较中，最后加入的63%条目带来的增益为+0.0113，且变化路径并非单调的。 分数随知识库的大小和构成而变化。 在相同50%规模的知识库中，若将其基础测试用例排除在外，得分为0.3894，相比包含这些测试用例的半规模知识库配置，损失了0.0937，这一损失大于将完整知识库规模减半时产生的0.0303的损失。 在此比较中，保留验证测试所带来的差异更为显著。

That range is several times the seed-to-seed spread of Table 29 , so we do not treat the gap as flat in b b : more attempts help the library-equipped configuration slightly more. The b = 8 b=8 Feedback run also supplies the executed comparison at nearly equal recorded-call cost to default LEGO ( $ 2.07 \$2.07 versus $ 2.08 \$2.08 ).

paragraphs.en: Table 27 extends the main-text model-allocation panel with measured scores, recorded-call costs, and score-normalized efficiency.
paragraphs.zh: 表 27 在正文的模型分配面板中补充了实测得分、录音通话成本以及经得分归一化的效率指标。

paragraphs.en: The allocations in the table change both delivery quality and recorded-call cost. The four terra-backbone rows span .4880 .4880 – .5134 .5134 , a score range of .0254 .0254 ( 4.9 % 4.9\% of the default), while their recorded-call costs span $ 1.58 \$1.58 – $ 2.53 \$2.53 ; moving the backbone from GPT-5.6-terra to Claude Sonnet 5 with Sonnet 5 in both adaptation and diagnosis costs .0212 .0212 in score, and moving it to DeepSeek-V3.2 with the adaptation and diagnosis held at terra costs .2663 .2663 . The cheapest configuration that still exceeds the diagnosis-equipped no-library baseline of .3469 .3469 is terra/GPT-OSS-20B/GPT-OSS-20B at $ 1.58 \$1.58 , which is $ 0.21 \$0.21 below that baseline’s own recorded-call cost — this configuration therefore has lower recorded-call cost and higher score, provided repository-level construction is kept and only adaptation and diagnosis are downgraded. Substituting a more expensive model moves cost the other way: Sonnet 5 at all three points costs $ 4.26 \$4.26 . The all-open-weight row ( .2050 .2050 at $ 0.08 \$0.08 ) is included to show the other end: at that recorded-call cost the framework recovers 20.5 % 20.5\% of the identity ceiling, and the observed score remains well below the default configuration.
paragraphs.zh: 表格中的分配方案同时改变了交付质量和录音通话成本。 四个 terra-backbone 行的分数范围从 .4880 – .5134，跨度为 .0254（占默认值的 4.9%），而它们的录音通话成本则从 $1.58 – $2.53；将 backbone 从 GPT-5.6-terra 更换为 Claude Sonnet 5（在适配和诊断阶段均使用 Sonnet 5）会使分数降低 .0212，而将其更换为 DeepSeek-V3.2 并保持适配和诊断成本与 terra 一致，则会使分数降低 .2663。 在仍高于配备诊断功能且无库的基准值 .3469 的配置中，最便宜的方案是 terra/GPT-OSS-20B/GPT-OSS-20B，成本为 $1.58，比该基准配置本身的录音通话成本低 $0.21——因此，只要保持仓库级构建不变，仅降级适配和诊断环节，该配置就能同时实现更低的录音通话成本和更高的分数。 替换为更昂贵的模型会使成本朝相反方向变化：在所有三个点上使用 Sonnet 5 的成本均为 $4.26。 全开源权重行（分数为 .2050，成本为 $0.08）被包含在内以展示另一极端情况：在该录音通话成本下，框架可恢复身份上限的 20.5%，而观测到的分数仍远低于默认配置。

paragraphs.en: How the per-task dollar figures are obtained. The $/task figures report recorded-call cost: recorded repository-level construction and diagnosis calls, successful adaptation calls only, and the fixed retrieval charge, priced using Table 28 . Mean per-task usage is 856 k input and 48 k output tokens for repository-level construction at the default attempt budget, 11 k / 2.3 k per adaptation over 7.4 successful adaptations, 18 k / 2.6 k per diagnosis round over 5 rounds, and a fixed $ 0.011 \$0.011 for embedding and reranking, which is model-independent. The scoped generic editor of RAG + + Edit uses 7 k / 1.9 k because it does not receive the primitive’s carried tests, metadata or execution state; the File RAG editor uses 9.5 k / 1.9 k because raw source files are longer than primitive bodies. At GPT-5.6-terra rates this gives $ 1.55 \$1.55 for Feedback and $ 2.08 \$2.08 for LEGO, and every substitution in Tables 22 , 23 and 27 uses the same recorded token accounting re-priced at the substituted model’s rate. A consequence worth stating is that substituting a more expensive model for adaptation or diagnosis raises rather than lowers the per-task cost.
paragraphs.zh: 每任务美元数值的获取方式。 每任务美元数值报告了已记录调用的成本：仅包括已记录的仓库级构建和诊断调用以及成功适配调用，并采用表28进行定价。 默认尝试预算下，仓库级构建的平均每任务使用量为输入856千个token和输出48千个token；7.4次成功适配中，每次适配平均使用11千/2.3千个token；5轮诊断中，每轮诊断平均使用18千/2.6千个token；嵌入和重排序的固定费用为0.011美元（$0.011），且该费用与模型无关。 RAG++ Edit的限定通用编辑器使用量为7千/1.9千，因为它未接收原始单元携带的测试、元数据或执行状态；File RAG编辑器的使用量为9.5千/1.9千，因为原始源文件比原始单元主体更长。 按GPT-5.6-terra的费率计算，反馈（Feedback）的费用为1.55美元（$1.55），LEGO的费用为2.08美元（$2.08）；表22、23和27中的每次替换均使用相同的已记录token计数，并按所替换模型的费率重新定价。 一个值得提及的结论是，将适配或诊断所用模型替换为更昂贵的模型，会导致每任务成本上升而非下降。

paragraphs.en: Two caveats attach to every cost figure reported here. The rates are a single snapshot and the open-weight models are priced as hosted deployments rather than as self-hosted inference, so the $ ⁣ / \$/ task columns compare procurement costs under one purchasing model and not the compute actually consumed; a reader running the open-weight primitives locally should expect a different and generally smaller marginal cost. And the price spread across this table is 100 × 100\times on input tokens ( $ 0.05 \$0.05 to $ 5.00 \$5.00 per million) while the delivery-score spread among the same models used for adaptation is .0309 .0309 (Table 22 ). That asymmetry, rather than any ranking within the table, is the finding RQ5 rests on.
paragraphs.zh: 此处报告的所有成本数据均附带两项注意事项。 这些费率仅为单一时点的快照，且开放权重模型是按托管部署而非自托管推理进行定价的，因此“$ ⁣ / \$/ task”列比较的是单一采购模式下的采购成本，而非实际消耗的算力；在本地运行开放权重基础模型的读者应预期其边际成本会有所不同，且通常更低。 此外，本表中输入令牌的价格跨度为 100 × 100\times（每百万个令牌从 $ 0.05 \$0.05 到 $ 5.00 \$5.00），而用于适配的相同模型在交付分数上的跨度仅为 .0309 .0309（表 22）。 RQ5 所依据的发现正是这种不对称性，而非表中任何排名。

paragraphs.en: Table 24 evaluates LEGO with each of the 13 13 backbone while holding the adaptation and diagnosis fixed. LEGO improves every backbone, with an average absolute gain of 0.1474 0.1474 . The absolute gain broadly increases with scratch performance, from + .1175 +.1175 for GLM-5 to + 0.1954 +0.1954 for GPT-5.6-terra, whereas the relative improvement follows the opposite pattern, ranging from + 61.4 % +61.4\% for GPT-5.6-terra to + 116.5 % +116.5\% for Nemotron-Super-3-120B. Thus, the construction process provides gains across the full range of evaluated backbone strengths rather than benefiting only the strongest backbone. The zero-score rate also decreases for every backbone, by 19.7 19.7 percentage points on average.
paragraphs.zh: 表24在保持自适应和诊断不变的情况下，评估了LEGO与13个基础模型中的每一个的表现。 LEGO提升了每个基础模型的性能，平均绝对增益为0.1474。 绝对增益随着基础模型的性能提升而普遍增加：从GLM-5的+0.1175到GPT-5.6-terra的+0.1954；而相对改进则呈现相反趋势，从GPT-5.6-terra的+61.4%到Nemotron-Super-3-120B的+116.5%。 因此，这种构建过程在评估的所有基础模型强度范围内都带来了性能提升，而不仅仅是为最强的基础模型带来好处。 每个基础模型的零分率也均有所下降，平均降低了19.7个百分点。

paragraphs.en: The component-level models tolerate substantially weaker models. Tables 22 and 23 change the adaptation and diagnosis models independently while holding the remaining positions fixed. In the adaptation channel, GPT-OSS-20B retains 79.7 % 79.7\% of the margin achieved by GPT-5.6-terra, while the lowest-scoring primitive configuration, Gemma-4-31B, still retains 73.2 % 73.2\% . Diagnosis channel is looser: GPT-OSS-20B retains 64.0 % 64.0\% of the frontier-model margin and Gemma-4-31B 62.5 % 62.5\% . The displayed adaptation and diagnosis score rankings are identical (Spearman ρ = 1.0 \rho=1.0 ), although the decrements differ in magnitude. The rankings therefore do not support independent degradation of the two channels. Some substitutions also reduce recorded-call cost, from $2.08 per task with GPT-5.6-terra in all three positions to as low as $1.81 when replacing adaptation. The nine adaptation configurations span 0.4825 0.4825 – 0.5134 0.5134 and the nine diagnosis configurations 0.5007 0.5007 – 0.5134 0.5134 . Both observed ranges exceed the primary-configuration seed standard deviations. Both are smaller than the score reduction from removing the corresponding mechanism, so we read them as “a weaker model in a locally scoped position costs little” rather than as a ranking of the substituted models.

paragraphs.en: Removing a mechanism entirely has a substantially larger effect than replacing it with the weaker models evaluated here. Relative to LEGO, removing primitive adaptation reduces the score by 0.1154 0.1154 , while removing diagnosis reduces it by 0.0339 0.0339 ; by comparison, the lowest-scoring adaptation and diagnosis substitutions are 0.0309 0.0309 and 0.0127 0.0127 below full LEGO, respectively. Together, these results suggest that the component-level models do not require the strongest available model to preserve most of their contribution, motivating the heterogeneous configurations studied in RQ5.
paragraphs.zh: 完全移除某个机制所产生的影响，远大于用本文评估的较弱模型来替代它。 与 LEGO 相比，移除基础适应机制会使分数降低 0.1154 0.1154，而移除诊断机制则会使分数降低 0.0339 0.0339；相比之下，得分最低的适应和诊断替代方案分别比完整的 LEGO 低 0.0309 0.0309 和 0.0127 0.0127。 综合来看，这些结果表明，组件级模型无需使用当前最强的可用模型，就能保留其大部分贡献，这也为研究问题 RQ5 中探讨的异构配置提供了依据。

paragraphs.en: Table 27 reports the quality–cost tradeoff under the hosted-inference rates used for the experiments. The diagnosis-equipped baseline reaches 0.3469 0.3469 at $ 1.79 \$1.79 per task, whereas default LEGO reaches 0.5134 0.5134 at $ 2.08 \$2.08 . paragraphs.en: Model allocation exposes quality–cost tradeoffs. Table 27 varies the three prompted positions jointly. Keeping GPT-5.6-terra as the backbone while moving the locally scoped adaptation and diagnosis to cheaper models preserves most of the default score: T/S/S reaches 0.5081 0.5081 at $ 2.53 \$2.53 , T/D4/D4 reaches 0.4934 0.4934 at $ 1.62 \$1.62 , and T/O/O reaches 0.4880 0.4880 at $ 1.58 \$1.58 . Replacing the backbone changes cost in either direction, depending on its own rate, and always costs quality. Moving to a cheaper one, D3/D4/D4 reaches .2338 .2338 at $ 0.33 \$0.33 ; moving to a more expensive one, S/S/S reaches .4869 .4869 at $ 4.26 \$4.26 . Together with the independent model substitutions in RQ4, these configurations suggest that maintaining a capable backbone is more important to delivery quality than using the strongest model for the locally scoped adaptation and diagnosis.

paragraphs.en: Two patterns are visible. Regressions become less frequent and smaller on average across these bands: from 20.5 % 20.5\% of D1 tasks at a mean loss of .118 .118 to 13.4 % 13.4\% of D5 tasks at .047 .047 . Across all tasks there are 326 326 improvements, 112 112 ties, and 84 84 regressions; the conditional mean gain is .336 .336 and the conditional mean loss is .089 .089 . These summaries describe the evaluated runs and do not establish why individual integrations fail. The markdown case illustrates a substantial regression involving a target-specific protocol, but it does not determine the prevalence of that failure mechanism. A retain-the-better-trajectory mitigation would require a separate evaluation.

paragraphs.en: The runtime funnel in Table 17 records 10.6 10.6 capability queries and 7.4 7.4 successful adaptations per task against a mean of 44 44 target modules, so adapted primitives cover 16.9 % 16.9\% of target modules in aggregate and 13.0 % 13.0\% on D5. We examine whether per-task improvement is associated with the number of successfully adapted primitives. Table 31 reports the association, including a within-band comparison. Both the raw and the within-band correlation are positive and the group means increase across all four adaptation-count groups. The first group holds 63 63 tasks with 0 0 – 2 2 successful adaptations and a mean gain of + .0123 +.0123 ; it does not isolate tasks with none. This is an association rather than evidence that library use causes the improvement: adaptation count may itself depend on task difficulty and construction success, and a scoped editor using the same candidates could yield similar counts.
paragraphs.zh: 表 17 中的运行时漏斗记录了每任务 10.6 个能力查询和 7.4 次成功适配，平均涉及 44 个目标模块；因此，已适配的原语总共覆盖了 16.9% 的目标模块，在 D5 上则覆盖了 13.0%。 我们研究了每任务的改进是否与成功适配的原语数量有关。 表 31 报告了这种关联，包括带内比较。 原始相关性和带内相关性均为正值，且所有四个适配次数组别的组均值均呈上升趋势。 第一组包含 63 个任务，其成功适配次数为 0–2 次，平均增益为 +0.0123；该组并未单独筛选出完全没有适配的任务。 这是一种关联，而非证明库的使用导致了改进：适配次数本身可能取决于任务难度和构建成功与否，而使用相同候选项的限定编辑器也可能产生类似的适配次数。

paragraphs.en: The rows separate two things that the aggregate confounds. paragraphs.en: Re-mining from a disjoint corpus. Because filtering on repository identity leaves forks and near-duplicates eligible, we re-mine CodeFace from 640 640 repositories disjoint from LEGO-REPO, yielding 518 518 primitives at 44.7 % 44.7\% coverage and 0.4528 0.4528 — + 0.1348 +0.1348 over Feedback , 69 % 69\% of the default margin, with band retention 88 % 88\% , 83 % 83\% , 73 % 73\% , 52 % 52\% , and 43 % 43\% on D1–D5, respectively. paragraphs.zh: 从互不相关的语料库中重新挖掘。 由于根据存储库身份进行筛选会使分叉和近似重复项仍具备资格，因此我们从与 LEGO-REPO 互不相关的 640 个存储库中重新挖掘 CodeFace，获得了 518 个基础单元，覆盖率为 44.7%，比 Feedback 高出 0.4528（+0.1348），占默认余量的 69%；在 D1–D5 上，带保留率分别为 88%、83%、73%、52% 和 43%。 这些带值均为整数百分比的摘要；汇总后的 69.0% 保留率使用了未经四舍五入的汇总得分差异。 该结果在所述互不相关语料库条件下保留了可观察到的正向增益，但并未证明所有可能的污染都已被消除。

paragraphs.en: Each external row of Table 2 runs the system’s own released harness at a pinned release, with its default scaffolding, tool set, and stopping rules unchanged. We hold fixed only the task set, the execution environment, and the grading pipeline, and we score whatever tree the system leaves behind using Eq. 8 and the same provenance gate. Our task adapter performs one translation: it presents a LEGO-REPO task in the input format each system expects. For OpenHands and Claude Code, which accept a repository directory and a natural-language instruction, it supplies the reconstruction tree and an instruction naming the package prefix, the public interface, and the native suite. For SWE-agent and Agentless, which expect an issue and a repository to localize within, it emits a synthetic issue containing the same interface and suite and a tree in which the target modules are absent; localization therefore has nothing to find and both systems operate in a mode they were not designed for, which is why their rows are marked ‡ \ddagger and are not read as statements about those systems’ capability. No system receives the frozen node identifiers, the floor and ceiling counts, or any CodeFace entry.
paragraphs.zh: 表2中的每一行外部测试用例都在一个固定版本上运行系统自身发布的测试框架，其默认脚手架、工具集和停止规则均保持不变。 我们仅保持任务集、执行环境和评分流程不变，并使用公式8以及相同的来源验证机制对系统最终生成的任何树结构进行评分。 我们的任务适配器执行一项转换：它将LEGO-REPO任务以每个系统所期望的输入格式呈现。 对于接受仓库目录和自然语言指令的OpenHands与Claude Code，该适配器会提供重构树以及一个命名了包前缀、公共接口和本地套件的指令。 对于需要问题描述和待定位仓库的SWE-agent与Agentless，该适配器会生成一个合成问题，其中包含相同的接口和套件，以及一个缺少目标模块的树结构；因此，定位过程实际上没有可查找的内容，这两个系统都运行在它们未被设计用于的模式中，这也是其所在行被标记为‡ \ddagger且不应被解读为对这些系统能力的陈述的原因。 没有任何系统会接收到冻结节点标识符、最低和最高计数，或任何CodeFace条目。
