sents.en: We hold fixed only the task set, the execution environment, and the grading pipeline, and we score whatever tree the system leaves behind using Eq. 8 and the same provenance gate.
sents.zh: 我们仅保持任务集、执行环境和评分流程不变，并使用公式8以及相同的来源验证机制对系统最终生成的任何树结构进行评分。

sents.en: Our task adapter performs one translation: it presents a LEGO-REPO task in the input format each system expects.
sents.zh: 我们的任务适配器执行一项转换：它将LEGO-REPO任务以每个系统所期望的输入格式呈现。

sents.en: For OpenHands and Claude Code, which accept a repository directory and a natural-language instruction, it supplies the reconstruction tree and an instruction naming the package prefix, the public interface, and the native suite.
sents.zh: 对于接受仓库目录和自然语言指令的OpenHands与Claude Code，该适配器会提供重构树以及一个命名了包前缀、公共接口和本地套件的指令。

sents.en: For SWE-agent and Agentless, which expect an issue and a repository to localize within, it emits a synthetic issue containing the same interface and suite and a tree in which the target modules are absent; localization therefore has nothing to find and both systems operate in a mode they were not designed for, which is why their rows are marked ‡ \ddagger and are not read as statements about those systems’ capability.
sents.zh: 对于需要问题描述和待定位仓库的SWE-agent与Agentless，该适配器会生成一个合成问题，其中包含相同的接口和套件，以及一个缺少目标模块的树结构；因此，定位过程实际上没有可查找的内容，这两个系统都运行在它们未被设计用于的模式中，这也是其所在行被标记为‡ \ddagger且不应被解读为对这些系统能力的陈述的原因。

sents.en: No system receives the frozen node identifiers, the floor and ceiling counts, or any CodeFace entry.
sents.zh: 没有任何系统会接收到冻结节点标识符、最低和最高计数，或任何CodeFace条目。

paragraphs.en: For each benchmark in Table 9 we take that benchmark’s task list, resolve each task to its upstream repository, and remove from CodeFace every entry whose recorded source repository matches — by URL, by canonical name, or by known fork relation — any of those repositories, before any task is run. This removes 31 31 entries for RepoZero, 12 12 for RepoGenesis, and 24 24 for RepoCraft, and we additionally apply the MinHash filter of Appendix G.17 at threshold 0.6 0.6 against each external target’s original sources, removing 47 47 , 19 19 and 38 38 further entries respectively. Under the resulting libraries the offline audit reaches 34.8 % 34.8\% of RepoZero target modules, 29.6 % 29.6\% on RepoGenesis and 31.4 % 31.4\% on RepoCraft, against 61.4 % 61.4\% on LEGO-REPO. Each benchmark’s own metric, grading script, and published protocol are used unmodified; we do not map any external score onto the LEGO-REPO scale.
paragraphs.zh: 对于表 9 中的每个基准测试，我们都会采用该基准测试的任务列表，将每个任务解析为其上游仓库，并在运行任何任务之前，从 CodeFace 中移除所有其记录源仓库（通过 URL、规范名称或已知的分支关系）与这些仓库之一相匹配的条目。 此举移除了 RepoZero 的 31 个条目、RepoGenesis 的 12 个条目以及 RepoCraft 的 24 个条目；此外，我们还在每个外部目标的原始源上应用了附录 G.17 中的 MinHash 过滤器，阈值设为 0.6，从而进一步移除了 47、19 和 38 个条目。 在由此产生的库中，离线审计覆盖了 RepoZero 目标模块的 34.8%、RepoGenesis 的 29.6% 以及 RepoCraft 的 31.4%，而 LEGO-REPO 的覆盖率为 61.4%。 每个基准测试均使用其自身的指标、评分脚本和已发布的协议，且未经修改；我们不会将任何外部分数映射到 LEGO-REPO 的评分体系上。

paragraphs.en: Removing diagnosis disables diagnosis-guided revision. Removing primitive adaptation passes retrieved implementations into repository-level composition without primitive transformation. Removing the whole library removes both retrieval and adaptation, which makes Feedback + + Diagnosis the matched no-library reference. Library-source ablations separately restrict CodeFace to mined, web-sourced, and/or harvested entries. The File RAG control replaces CodeFace entirely: it indexes the raw source files of the same donor repositories with the same embedding model and retrieval depth, and returns whole files with no recovered boundary, no internalized helpers, no resolved dependency closure, no interface contract, and no carried tests. Everything downstream — the scoped generic editing, diagnosis, the attempt budget, and the grading pipeline — is unchanged, so the contrast isolates the primitive-construction pipeline of Section 3.3 rather than the retrieval mechanism.
paragraphs.zh: 移除诊断功能会禁用由诊断引导的修订。 移除原始适应机制会将检索到的实现直接纳入仓库级别的组合，而无需进行原始转换。 移除整个库将同时移除检索和适应功能，这使得“反馈 + 诊断”成为与无库参考相匹配的模式。 对库来源的消融分析分别将 CodeFace 限制在挖掘、网络获取和/或采集的条目上。 File RAG 控制完全取代了 CodeFace：它使用相同的嵌入模型和检索深度，对来自相同源仓库的原始源文件进行索引，并返回完整的文件，不包含任何恢复的边界、内化的辅助工具、已解析的依赖闭包、接口契约或随附的测试。 所有下游环节——范围限定的通用编辑、诊断、尝试预算以及评分流程——均保持不变，因此这种对比凸显了第 3.3 节中的原始构建流程，而非检索机制本身。

paragraphs.en: Structured-schema adaptation replaces the free-form adaptation request with a fixed structured payload: a typed field-mapping specification naming the target signatures, the symbols to export and the sibling bindings, with no channel for stating intent in prose. The primitive, its fields, the retrieval depth, diagnosis and the attempt budget are unchanged, so the contrast isolates the request channel.
paragraphs.zh: 结构化模式适配将自由形式的适配请求替换为固定的结构化负载：一种带类型的字段映射规范，其中指定了目标签名、要导出的符号以及兄弟绑定，但没有用于以文本形式说明意图的通道。 该原语、其字段、检索深度、诊断和尝试预算均未改变，因此这种对比凸显了请求通道的差异。

paragraphs.en: Two further controls change what the retrieved primitive is permitted to become (Table 6 ). Import + + Call copies the selected primitive unchanged into a _vendor/ package outside the target source prefix, exposes it on the path, and instructs LEGO to import and call it; adaptation is never invoked and the primitive’s implementation is byte-identical to its CodeFace entry. Because the target modules are still generated by the backbone, the provenance gate of Eq. 9 is unchanged, and a delivered tree whose target modules are thin wrappers over _vendor/ is admissible — which is the point of the control. Context-only performs the same retrieval and relevance assessment but places the primitive’s implementation, contract, and carried tests in the repository-level prompt as read-only reference; no file from the primitive reaches the delivered tree, and LEGO writes every delivered line. Both controls keep diagnosis, the attempt budget, the retrieval depth, and the grading pipeline unchanged. Same-repository donor exclusion is different: for each target it filters entries by source repository while leaving the evaluation tasks unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 另外两种控制机制会改变检索到的原始元素被允许变成什么（表 6）。 Import ++ Call 会将选中的原始元素原封不动地复制到目标源前缀之外的 _vendor/ 包中，在路径上暴露它，并指示 LEGO 导入和调用它；此时绝不会触发适配，且该原始元素的实现与其 CodeFace 条目完全字节一致。 由于目标模块仍由主干生成，方程 9 中的来源门保持不变，因此一个其目标模块仅为 _vendor/ 的薄包装层的交付树是可接受的——这正是这种控制机制的目的。 Context-only 执行相同的检索和相关性评估，但将原始元素的实现、契约和附带测试作为只读参考放入仓库级提示中；没有来自该原始元素的任何文件会进入交付树，而 LEGO 会编写交付的每一行代码。 这两种控制机制都保持诊断、尝试预算、检索深度和评分流程不变。 同一仓库捐赠者排除机制则不同：对于每个目标，它会按源仓库过滤条目，同时保持评估任务不变。

paragraphs.en: This D5 task has 105 105 modules, ceiling 1,807 1{,}807 , and floor 1,577 1{,}577 , leaving 230 230 tests in the normalized span. The unusually high floor is a property of the target: its suite is parametrized across several dataframe backends, and a large share of those parametrizations resolve to a skip or to a backend-availability assertion that passes without any reconstructed validation logic. The feedback baseline earns about 5 5 tests above the floor and LEGO earns 183 183 . The offline audit covers 61 61 of the 105 105 modules ( 58.1 % 58.1\% ); the retrieved material comes from 15 15 donor repositories, including 17 17 adapted primitives from marshmallow , whose field-coercion and error-collection components carry over to a schema-validation target with signature changes but no change of purpose. The example illustrates why floor subtraction matters and how validation logic transfers across repositories that share a problem rather than a codebase.
paragraphs.zh: 这项 D5 任务包含 105 个模块，上限为 1,807，下限为 1,577，因此归一化区间内剩余 230 项测试。 异常高的下限是目标本身的特性：其套件跨多个数据框后端进行参数化，而这些参数化配置中很大一部分最终会跳过验证，或仅执行一个无需任何重构验证逻辑即可通过的后端可用性断言。 反馈基线比下限多获得约 5 项测试，而 LEGO 则获得了 183 项。 离线审计覆盖了 105 个模块中的 61 个（58.1%）；检索到的材料来自 15 个捐赠仓库，其中包括从 marshmallow 中适配而来的 17 个基础组件，其字段强制和错误收集部分被继承到了一个签名有所变化但目的未变的模式验证目标中。 这个例子说明了为何需要减去下限，以及当不同仓库共享同一问题而非相同代码库时，验证逻辑是如何传递的。

paragraphs.en: The offline audit covers about 145 145 of the task’s 298 298 modules ( 48.7 % 48.7\% ), with candidates from 30 30 donor repositories, yet neither configuration produces an importable package and both score zero against a 5,876 5{,}876 -test ceiling. The failure is not in any individual component but in the target’s plugin registry: components are discovered through a decorator that registers them into a global type index, and a tree in which that index is incomplete does not import at all, so the suite cannot be collected and no partial credit is available. Substantial reusable coverage therefore does not by itself guarantee repository-level integration, and on targets whose module graph has a single point of failure the delivery score is all-or-nothing.
paragraphs.zh: 离线审计涵盖了该任务 298 个模块中的约 145 个（48.7%），候选智能体来自 30 个捐赠仓库，但两种配置都无法生成可导入的包，并且在 5,876 的测试上限下得分均为零。 问题并非出在任何单个组件上，而是出在目标系统的插件注册表中：组件通过一个装饰器被发现并注册到全局类型索引中，而包含不完整索引的树结构根本无法导入，因此整个套件无法被收集，也无法获得任何部分分数。 因此，大量的可重用覆盖范围本身并不能保证仓库级别的集成；在模块图存在单一故障点的目标系统中，交付得分是全有或全无的。

paragraphs.en: Several limitations qualify our conclusions. LEGO-REPO evaluates Python package reconstruction from supplied interfaces and native tests, so a score of 1 1 reflects agreement with the original package under the frozen suite rather than complete semantic correctness, maintainability, or unconstrained architecture design. The difficulty bands depend on hand-set coefficients, and most backbone, role, domain, and difficulty comparisons are single-sample, although repeated-seed and corrected statistical analyses are provided for the primary configurations. CodeFace provenance is another important threat: harvested primitives can descend from benchmark-related construction runs, and repository-level exclusion cannot eliminate forks, vendored copies, near-duplicates, or model-pretraining contamination. Because Section 5.4 filters by target repository only, one evaluation task can also supply verified primitives to another; such cross-task entries remain eligible. Stricter mined-only and fully disjoint CodeFace variants retain the qualitative gain but reduce its magnitude, particularly on the hardest tasks. External-benchmark improvements are likewise smaller than on LEGO-REPO, so we claim transfer in direction rather than magnitude. Several retrieval and library controls are our implementations of prior design patterns rather than published systems, and diagnosis-guided revision itself is not novel. The generic-editing and raw-source controls change component fields together, while sequential field increments depend on the comparison configuration and addition order; these contrasts measure combined changes and conditional increments rather than independent causal contributions. The experiments evaluate complete self-adapting components with carried validation. LEGO can also regress when reused components interact poorly with plugin, registry, or entry-point protocols. Finally, adapted primitives are incorporated into the delivered source, so donor-license obligations may propagate; CodeFace records provenance and licenses but does not enforce compatibility. Exact historical replay is also not guaranteed because some dependencies resolve against live package infrastructure.
paragraphs.zh: 有几项局限性会影响我们的结论。 LEGO-REPO 通过提供的接口和本地测试来评估 Python 包的重建效果，因此得分为 1 的结果反映的是在固定测试套件下与原始包的一致性，而非完全符合语义正确性、可维护性或不受约束的架构设计。 难度等级取决于手动设置的系数，且大多数骨干、角色、领域和难度的比较均为单样本测试，尽管主要配置提供了重复种子和修正后的统计分析。 CodeFace 的来源追溯是另一个重要威胁：采集到的原始组件可能源自与基准测试相关的构建运行，而仓库级别的排除机制无法消除分叉、内嵌副本、近似重复项或模型预训练带来的污染。 由于第 5.4 节仅按目标仓库进行过滤，一个评估任务也可能向另一个任务提供经过验证的原始组件；此类跨任务的条目仍然有效。 更严格的“仅挖掘”和“完全分离”的 CodeFace 变体保留了定性上的优势，但会减弱其程度，尤其是在最困难的任务中。 外部基准测试中的改进同样小于 LEGO-REPO 的情况，因此我们认为这种迁移主要体现在方向上，而非程度上。 多种检索和库相关的控制机制是我们对先前设计模式的实现，而非已发布的系统，且诊断引导的修订本身也并非创新。 通用编辑和原始源代码控制会同时修改组件字段，而顺序字段增量则取决于比较配置和添加顺序；这些对比衡量的是联合变化和条件增量，而非独立的因果贡献。 这些实验评估了带有附带验证的完整自适应组件。 当重复使用的组件与插件、注册表或入口点协议交互不良时，LEGO 也可能出现性能退化。 最后，经过适配的原始组件会被整合到交付的源代码中，因此捐赠许可的义务可能会延续；CodeFace 会记录来源和许可信息，但不会强制确保兼容性。 也无法保证完全的历史重演，因为某些依赖项会解析到实时的包基础设施上。

paragraphs.en: The security hold set is checked against materialized task directories using repository names, metadata, descriptions, and upstream URLs. Two repositories reached materialization before the broader screen identified them and are excluded from all reported results. The same exclusions apply when CodeFace is loaded and when it is saved, so a held repository can neither be evaluated nor become a donor. Task and primitive metadata retain repository URLs, commit identifiers, and licenses. Reproduction retrieves source from upstream under its original license, and task definitions and grading keys can be distributed separately from source code.
paragraphs.zh: 安全保留集通过仓库名称、元数据、描述和上游 URL，与已实现的任务目录进行比对。 在更广泛的筛选机制识别出它们之前，已有两个仓库完成了实现，因此被排除在所有报告结果之外。 在加载和保存 CodeFace 时都适用相同的排除规则，因此被保留的仓库既无法被评估，也无法成为贡献源。 任务和基础元素的元数据会保留仓库 URL、提交标识符和许可证信息。 再生产功能会根据原始许可证从上游获取源代码，而任务定义和评分标准可以与源代码分开分发。

sents.en: The security hold set is checked against materialized task directories using repository names, metadata, descriptions, and upstream URLs.
sents.zh: 安全保留集通过仓库名称、元数据、描述和上游 URL，与已实现的任务目录进行比对。

sents.en: Two repositories reached materialization before the broader screen identified them and are excluded from all reported results.
sents.zh: 在更广泛的筛选机制识别出它们之前，已有两个仓库完成了实现，因此被排除在所有报告结果之外。

sents.en: The same exclusions apply when CodeFace is loaded and when it is saved, so a held repository can neither be evaluated nor become a donor.
sents.zh: 在加载和保存 CodeFace 时都适用相同的排除规则，因此被保留的仓库既无法被评估，也无法成为贡献源。

sents.en: Task and primitive metadata retain repository URLs, commit identifiers, and licenses.
sents.zh: 任务和基础元素的元数据会保留仓库 URL、提交标识符和许可证信息。

sents.en: Reproduction retrieves source from upstream under its original license, and task definitions and grading keys can be distributed separately from source code.
sents.zh: 再生产功能会根据原始许可证从上游获取源代码，而任务定义和评分标准可以与源代码分开分发。

paragraphs.en: The provenance gate establishes that generated code was imported by the suite, but not that it implements the capability rather than satisfying the assertions. Annotators therefore worked from a fixed instruction: “Read the generated module and the graded tests it passes. Label genuine if the module would behave correctly on inputs outside the graded tests; partial if it is a correct implementation of a strict subset of the declared contract; special-casing if any graded assertion is satisfied by a hard-coded value, an input-value branch, or a comparison against a literal copied from the test; stub if the module has no implementation of the capability at all. When in doubt between adjacent categories, choose the less favourable one.” Disagreements were resolved by discussion for the counts in Table 37 .
paragraphs.zh: 来源验证机制可以确认生成的代码是由该套件导入的，但无法确认该代码是否真正实现了所需功能，而不仅仅是满足了断言条件。 因此，标注人员依据一条固定的说明进行操作：“阅读生成的模块以及它通过的分级测试。” 如果该模块在分级测试之外的输入上也能正确运行，则标记为“真实”；如果它仅正确实现了声明契约的一个严格子集，则标记为“部分”；如果任何分级断言都通过硬编码值、输入值分支或与从测试中复制的字面量进行比较而满足，则标记为“特殊处理”；如果该模块完全没有实现所需功能，则标记为“占位符”。 当相邻类别之间难以抉择时，应选择较不利的类别。”表37中的计数通过讨论解决了分歧。

paragraphs.en: Direction. The sample counts favour LEGO: genuine implementations rise from 74 74 to 100 100 , partial from 33 33 to 14 14 , special-casing from 9 9 to 5 5 , and stubs from 4 4 to 1 1 . These category counts do not establish how test-targeted behaviour affects the benchmark-wide score margin. A paired significance test requires the task-level discordant labels, which are not recoverable from these marginal counts; no paired p p -value is reported here. A primitive is accountable to its own carried tests rather than to the target’s graded suite, which is a plausible mechanism, but we do not test it.
paragraphs.zh: 方向。 样本计数显示 LEGO 占优：真实实现从 74 74 增至 100 100，部分实现从 33 33 降至 14 14，特殊处理从 9 9 降至 5 5，而占位符则从 4 4 降至 1 1。 这些类别计数无法确定测试导向的行为如何影响整个基准测试的分数差距。 配对显著性检验需要任务层面的不一致标签，而这些标签无法从上述边缘计数中恢复；此处未报告任何配对 p 值。 一个原语需对其自身携带的测试负责，而非目标对象的分级测试套件；这是一种合理的机制，但我们并未对此进行测试。

paragraphs.en: Sensitivity within the audited sample. Treat all 6 6 degenerate LEGO reconstructions ( 5.0 % 5.0\% ; special-casing plus stubs) as spurious and zero them, while fully crediting all 13 13 degenerate baseline reconstructions ( 10.8 % 10.8\% ). A normalized score cannot exceed 1 1 , so this removes at most 6 / 120 = 0.05 6/120=0.05 from LEGO’s mean over the audited sample. This calculation is not a bound on the 522 522 -task mean or its contrast with Feedback: the sample is restricted to tasks scoring nonzero under both configurations and does not cover all tasks on which test-targeted behaviour could affect a score.

paragraphs.en: What remains uncovered. The reported LEGO Wilson upper bounds are 9.4 % 9.4\% for special-casing and 4.6 % 4.6\% for stubs; these are separate category-rate intervals within the audited sample, not bounds on score differences. The generic-editing arm was not audited, so this audit does not establish that the primitive-versus-editor contrast is degeneracy-free. Both arms see the same retrieved primitives under the same test visibility, but this design does not replace a direct audit. The limitation applies to the field-level decomposition of Section 5.4 and prevents treating the audit as a guarantee about the full + 0.1954 +0.1954 contrast.
paragraphs.zh: 尚未被揭示的部分。 报告中的 LEGO Wilson 上限为：特殊处理情形下为 9.4%（9.4\%），断点情形下为 4.6%（4.6\%）；这些是审计样本中不同类别的独立比率区间，而非分数差异的上限。 通用编辑分支并未经过审计，因此本次审计无法证明原始元素与编辑器之间的对比不存在退化问题。 两个分支在相同测试可见性条件下都会看到相同的检索原始元素，但这种设计并不能替代直接审计。 这一局限性适用于第 5.4 节的字段级分解，并使得无法将本次审计视为对完整 +0.1954（+0.1954）对比的保证。

paragraphs.en: Adapted primitives are written into the delivered source, so donor license terms propagate to the generated repository rather than being satisfied by a dependency declaration. The evaluated system applies no license filter at retrieval time, so the 214 214 copyleft entries ( 15.0 % 15.0\% ) in Table 38 are eligible unless an experiment’s source restrictions exclude them, and their terms can propagate into a generated repository. We state this explicitly rather than describing a filter we did not run.
paragraphs.zh: 经过调整的原始代码会被写入交付的源代码中，因此捐赠许可条款会传播到生成的仓库中，而不是通过依赖声明来满足。 所评估的系统在检索时未应用任何许可过滤器，因此表 38 中的 214 个 214 项共版权条目（15.0% 15.0\%）是符合条件的，除非某个实验的源代码限制排除了这些条目，并且它们的条款可以传播到生成的仓库中。 我们明确说明这一点，而不是描述一个我们并未运行的过滤器。

paragraphs.en: This section provides the system prompts used by the three LLM-based positions in LEGO: retrieval and activation , Code Primitive interaction , and verification and diagnosis . Task-specific requests, retrieved candidates, primitive states, repository context, and execution evidence are inserted into the corresponding placeholders during inference. Retrieval itself and repository execution are performed outside the LLM; their results are supplied to the corresponding prompted component.
paragraphs.zh: 本节介绍了 LEGO 中三个基于大型语言模型（LLM）的角色所使用的系统提示：检索与激活、代码原语交互，以及验证与诊断。 在推理过程中，任务特定的请求、检索到的候选项、原语状态、知识库上下文和执行证据会被插入到相应的占位符中。 检索过程本身以及知识库的执行都在 LLM 之外完成；其结果会提供给对应的提示组件。
